star_system.skill_level_unlocks: Skill Lv1 at 0 stars (just owning the character), Skill Lv2 at 2 stars, Skill Lv3 at 5 stars, Skill Lv4 at 7 stars. Skill level is separate from star/character level.
star_system.note: Stars 1, 4, and 7 give the same stat boost per character (e.g. Alex gets [All] Max HP +3% each time). Stars 3 and 6 each unlock a resonance slot. Star 7 gives both a stat boost AND skill level 4.
star_system.how_stars_are_earned: Stars are unlocked by collecting hero shards (the 'X/150' or 'X/100' counter on hero cards).
star_system.all_buff_unlocks: [All] buffs unlock at stars 1/4/7 - three per hero, each a permanent global bonus across the account.
star_system.resonance_unlocks: Resonance unlocks at 3 stars, with a second slot at 6 stars.
star_system.all_buff_meaning: The '[All]' prefix on a star-up bonus means it applies to every hero you own, not just the hero being starred up. Examples: '[All] CRIT DMG REDUC +15%', '[All] CRIT Rate +4%'.
star_system.strategy: Because 1/4/7 star bonuses are account-wide, even heroes you never plan to play are worth starring for the global buffs.

resonance.description: Resonance allows characters to equip skills from other characters you own.
resonance.unlock_at: Star 3 (+1 slot) and Star 6 (+1 slot, 2 total)
resonance.how_it_works: A 6-star character can equip 2 borrowed skills from other characters in addition to their own skill. The borrowed skill uses the level from the character who owns it.
resonance.example: A 6-star Dracoola can equip Hou Yi's Sun Piercer and Nyanja's Cloudfooted if you own those characters.
resonance.pvp_note: Phynx's Desert Tribunal is widely considered the best resonance skill for PvP.
resonance.character_skills_row: 2 slots total. Slot 1 unlocks at 3 stars, slot 2 at 6 stars. Each holds another hero's signature kit at whatever level you have unlocked on the source hero.
resonance.skin_skills_row: 4 slots total, fixed count, unlocked progressively via Sacred Hall privileges ('+1 skin talent(s) of character in Resonance slot #N'). Once unlocked, fill with skin talents from any character.
resonance.resonance_section: The Resonance section below the slots lists the cumulative effects of everything currently equipped across both rows.
resonance.max_loadout: A 6-star hero with Sacred Hall progress can wield their own kit + 2 borrowed hero kits + 4 borrowed skin skills simultaneously.
resonance.strategic_implication: Resonance makes building multiple heroes deep valuable even if you only play one. Levelling secondary heroes and starring up skins unlocks stronger things to resonate into your main.

characters._coverage: Source documents 6 Rare, 6 Epic and 5 Legendary heroes. Source states more Epic and Legendary heroes likely exist beyond those catalogued.
characters.rarity_tiers: Heroes are grouped into three rarity pools: Rare, Epic, Legendary. Each pool contains different heroes.
characters.rarity_is_fixed: Each hero is locked to one rarity and never ascends tiers (Otta is always Legendary, Alex is always Rare).
characters.rarity_vs_power: Rarity does not directly imply power. A fully-leveled lower-rarity hero can outperform a low-star higher-rarity hero.
characters.acquisition_daily_rewards: Daily Rewards Bonus Pack gives random shards for the selected hero (default Phynx); shard quantity scales with rarity (x1 70%, x2 25%).
characters.acquisition_limited_offers: Limited Offer packs supply event/seasonal hero shards.
characters.acquisition_event_only_heroes: The event-only heroes — obtainable ONLY during a limited-time event — are: Nezha, Wukong, Rick, and Morty. Nezha and Wukong each return with their own recurring event; Rick and Morty come from [Interdimensional Summon] during the Archero 2 x Rick and Morty collab.
characters.acquisition_not_from_chests_or_hunt: Hero shards do NOT drop from Mythstone or Chromatic Chests, and do NOT drop from Hunt. Chests give gear; Hunt gives gear, runes, gear scrolls, gold and EXP only.
characters.shards: Heroes are unlocked and starred up with shards, shown as an 'X/Y' counter on the hero card (X/150 and X/100 counters observed). Sources: Daily Rewards Bonus Pack, Limited Offer packs, events. Not Hunt.
characters.shard_exchange: Excess hero shards convert one-way into Character Shadows, not into other heroes' shards.
characters.unique_skill_kits: Each hero has one named signature ability set that levels across 4 tiers as the hero stars up. The kit name is unique per hero.
characters.outfit_button: The Outfit button on the hero portrait is where skins and cosmetics are applied to the hero.

gold.description: Gold is the primary currency in Archero 2. It has two main uses: buying items in the general store and leveling up gear.
gold.gear_leveling: The main use of gold. Gear levels are tied to the equipment slot, not the individual item. For example, if your boots are level 148, every pair of boots you equip will be level 148 — whether they're Mythic Griffin or Legendary Oracle. This means upgrading gear level benefits any item in that slot. Gets very expensive at higher levels.
gold.general_store: Gold can be used to purchase items from the general store.
gold.profile_level_cards: Gold can also be used to buy profile-level-up cards when you reach each 10th profile level. You can buy 10 cards per level; they are randomly generated (e.g. Health increase, skill refresh, Red heart healing+, speed bonus). This is a rarer, sometimes expensive use of gold.
gold.gear_tiers_vs_levels: Gear tier is specific to the individual piece of equipment (e.g. Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic). Gear level is specific to the slot (boots, weapon, armor, etc.) and applies to whatever item is equipped in that slot.
gold.community_weapon_cap: There are 2 main uses for gold. Leveling up weapons and purchasing talent cards. As of the most recent update, Weapon max level will raise to 200 from 150. Talent cards can be bought every 10 levels but max out at level 50 currently. With level 60 add, we will see if they add more

guild.donations: Guild donations: You can donate 5 times per day. The first donation is free, then costs increase by 20 gems each (free → 20 → 40 → 60 → 80). Donations are how guilds level up.
guild.first_donation_daily: The first guild donation of the day is free.
guild.overview: Guilds are persistent social groups with shared progression and competitive content. The Guild hub is a map view of buildings, each its own sub-feature. The building list here predates the Starlight Gala, which the August 2026 notes add as a new guild feature without saying whether it is a building.
guild.member_cap: Up to 30 members at base. Raising the guild level increases the member cap.
guild.leadership: Leaders can appoint Vice Leaders to help manage. Leaders cannot leave the guild — they must transfer leadership or be the last person to disband it.
guild.inactive_leader: Leadership auto-transfers when a leader is inactive for 7 days.
guild.hub_buildings: Guild Hall (members, roles, research, leaderboard), Monster Invasion (guild boss raids), Guild Expedition (multi-guild PvP tournament), Shop / Guild Store (hero shards and random Epic runes), Guild Merchant (community bargain mechanic), and Guild Aid. The Starlight Gala was added later and is not in this list.

guild_hall.member_row: Each member row shows avatar, role, name, power level, daily contribution count, contribution score, and online/offline status.
guild_hall.roles: Leader (1), Vice Leader (multiple, appointed by the Leader), and Guild Members.
guild_hall.buttons: Log (guild activity history: joins, leaves, kicks with timestamps), Guild Research, and Manage Member (kick / promote, Leader and Vice Leader only).

guild_research.overview: A grid of unlockable research nodes, each with 5 levels (Lv 1-5). Each node grants a buff that applies to all members of the guild.
guild_research.how_it_works: Each node has a Needed Research EXP bar. Members donate to push the bar; once filled the node levels up and the buff applies guild-wide. Node popups show current level, current effect, next level effect, donation rewards (EXP + currencies), and today's remaining battle chances.
guild_research.tiers: Most node names appear in Tier I and Tier II variants (e.g. Vitality I to Vitality II). Tier II is the higher unlock, only available after maxing Tier I.
guild_research.node_types: Two kinds of node: most grant incremental stat buffs on a Lv 1-5 ladder, while some are content unlocks (e.g. Clash Clearance II unlocks higher-tier Monster Invasion chests) with no per-level stat.
guild_research.contribution_tracking: Research shows your weekly contribution and your weekly ranking within the guild, plus a Guild Rankings button for global guild leaderboards.

nodes.vitality_ii: Max HP. Higher tier of Vitality I; per-level ladder not captured.
nodes.scroll_boost_i: Stage/Hunt Scroll Gain. Per-level ladder not captured.
nodes.training_boost_ii: Stage/Hunt EXP Gain. Per-level ladder not captured.

nodes.coordinated_hunt: More damage vs elites +4% / +8% / +12% / +16% / +20% across Lv 1-5. Single tier.

nodes.clash_clearance_ii: Content unlock: unlocks Monster Invasion chest tiers (maxed unlocks Tier 10-12 chests).
nodes.other_nodes_observed: Node names seen but with effects not documented: Clash, Stamina Cycle II, Contribution Return II, Assist Accel II, Reflexes, Assist Enhancement II.

guild_research.strategy: Research is the cleanest source of permanent guild-wide stat buffs, and they apply to every member, so donating is high-leverage even for nodes you will not personally use. Focus Tier II of the stats your build prioritizes — Battle Will II for ATK builds, Vitality II for tanky builds, Wealth Boost II for gold farming.

monster_invasion.overview: A guild-wide boss raid where members collectively damage a single boss for tiered rewards.
monster_invasion.boss_rotation: The boss rotates daily. A Boss Refresh Timer counts down to the next rotation, and a Chance Refresh Timer limits attempts per member per cycle.
monster_invasion.damage_thresholds: Per-day damage milestones each player must hit to claim each reward tier: 30M / 60M / 100M+ chests.
monster_invasion.buttons: Quick Raid (auto-resolve attempts, extended by the Sealing Master privilege card), Practice (test runs that cost no chances and give no rewards), Start (manual run), and Preset (load a saved gear/rune loadout).
monster_invasion.guild_ranking: Monster Invasion has a global guild ranking based on total guild damage summed across all members for each daily boss rotation. Rewards are sent via mail at the end of each round.

ranking_rewards.note: Guild Coins / secondary currency, sent by mail to all members of qualifying guilds at the end of each daily round. Values for the top 4 ranks were not captured.

monster_invasion.strategy: Being in a Top-100 guild is a meaningful daily Guild Coin source. The driver is total guild damage, so a guild with many members hitting the per-player milestones out-damages one with only a few high-damage members.
monster_invasion.alias: Monster Invasion is commonly shortened to MI in guild chat. A question about 'MI' means Monster Invasion.
monster_invasion.guild_requirement: The Arch 2 Addicts guilds require 2 Monster Invasion (MI) runs per day as a minimum activity standard, for both XYIAN OFFICIAL and ProjectXY. That is a guild rule set by XYIAN, not a game rule — Archero 2 itself does not require a number of runs.

guild_expedition.overview: A multi-guild PvP tournament with seasonal rounds. Your guild faces other guilds in deployment-based combat.
guild_expedition.eligibility: Guild must be Lv.3 or higher and have at least 10 members registered. Members must personally register. Each route has a deploy cap and stronger members are deployed first, but all registered members earn rewards even if not deployed.

weekly_schedule.registration: Mon 00:00 - Tue 23:59. Members register and select a battle route.
weekly_schedule.prep_phase: Wed 00:00 - Thu 23:59. Leaders and Vice Leaders assign deployed members for all 3 routes; members spend Expedition Hearts to recharge Expedition Talents and gain buffs.
weekly_schedule.battle_phase: Fri 00:00 - Sun 23:59. Round-robin combat. Deployments and character progress lock at Fri 12:00 UTC, and the opposing guild's deployment becomes viewable within 2 hours after lock.

guild_expedition.format: A group of 4 guilds competes round-robin, giving 3 matches per guild per cycle. Each match has 3 routes (Left / Middle / Right); each route deploys 8 members and the top 8 by Battle Power per lane fight. Capturing flags across the 3 routes determines wins.
guild_expedition.combat_rules: Matches use spectator mode with the arena's presets. Characters' HP and ATK use default values rather than live stats, so gear and runes do not directly determine fight outcomes — talent and Expedition Talents do. The guild that defeats all enemy players on a route claims that route's flag.
guild_expedition.season_structure: A season lasts 12 weeks (84 days) across 12 rounds of 1 week each. Performance accumulates league points across rounds, driving promotion or demotion at season end.
guild_expedition.match_scoring: Within a round: a win (more flags captured) is 3 points and a draw (equal flags) is 1 point each. These determine placement within your weekly 4-guild bracket.
guild_expedition.round_points: End-of-round bracket placement gives league points: 1st +50, 2nd +35, 3rd +10, 4th -15.
guild_expedition.win_streak_bonus: Win streaks add bonus points: a 2-match win streak gives +5, a 3-match win streak gives +10.

season_reset.note: At season reset a guild's points auto-reset to a soft floor based on final points — higher finishes keep more progress.

guild_expedition.season_rewards: Rewards are tallied based on the final tier reached in the season. Players must be registered for at least 3 weeks of matches to be eligible; if the guild itself participated fewer than 3 weeks, players must participate in all available matches (exact wording was cut off in the source).
guild_expedition.leagues: The label under each guild's name on the round screen is its league. Thunderbound Oath and Dragonbound are the two leagues documented, with Dragonbound the higher one. Thunderbound Oath spans the 900-1,199 point band; sub-tier range is 100 points. The full league ladder was not captured.
guild_expedition.expedition_talents: A talent tree unlocked through registration and the Prep Phase. Members spend Expedition Hearts to power it up, and talents apply to the entire guild during the upcoming Battle Phase. Examples observed: all members gain DMG Reflect (CD 1s, upgradeable to 1.5s), DMG Reflect reduced +15%, Healing reduced +20%, Hit Rate +20%, and +1% DMG to all members on a lane for each additional guild member that joins that lane (calculated per lane independently).
guild_expedition.deployment_screen: Shows 3 lanes (Left / Middle / Right) with participants per lane and total power per lane. Among the members of each route, the top 8 in Battle Power join the battle; registered but undeployed members still earn rewards. Presets save deployment configurations.

guild_store.overview: The guild's daily-rotating shop, primarily for hero shards and random Epic runes. Refreshes every 24h.
guild_store.hero_shards: Alex, Nyanja, Helix, Hela, Mymu, and Hou Yi shards at 900 Guild Coins each, limit 50 purchases each per day.
guild_store.runes: Random Epic Enhancement Rune, Random Epic Ability Rune, and Random Epic Blessing Rune, bought with gems, limit 10 each.
guild_store.strategy: All 6 hero shards on offer are Rare-tier heroes, so the Guild Store is a strong farm path for Rare hero progression — up to 300 Rare hero shards per day per member.
guild_store.shop_tabs: Sub-tabs at the bottom of the Shop: Guild Store (default), Guild Expedition Shop, Event Shop, Arena Shop, and Skin Exchange Shop.
guild_store.promised_ruin_shovel: The Promised Ruin Shovel was added to the Guild Shop in this update. The notes do not say which sub-tab carries it, what it costs, or what it is used for. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.

guild_expedition_shop.overview: A tab inside the Guild Shop selling themed random Epic runes plus specific named runes. Refreshes roughly every 2 days.
guild_expedition_shop.currency: Paid for with a currency earned from Guild Expedition (2,700 per item; the source could not confirm the currency name, likely Expedition Coins).
guild_expedition_shop.items: Random Epic Circle, Meteor, Sword Strike, Sprite, Main Weapon, Elemental, Plant, and Blessing Runes, plus Arrow of Echoes (a specific Etched rune). All at 2,700 with 1 purchase each.
guild_expedition_shop.strategy: The cleanest path for theme-targeted rune farming — if you are building a Sprite or Plant build, the Random Epic [Theme] Rune options let you spend Expedition currency directly toward that theme.

guild_merchant.overview: A community-driven bargain mechanic. Guild members collectively contribute bargains to lower the price of merchant items for the whole guild. Items rotate daily.
guild_merchant.how_it_works: A panda merchant offers items each day at a base price in gems. Each member can place a Bargain, a small contribution toward the price cut. The more members who Bargain, the cheaper items get for everyone.
guild_merchant.refunds: The price difference is returned via mail the next day, so anyone who bought at a higher price is refunded once the cut is finalized.
guild_merchant.daily_window: The bargain runs on a daily timer window.
guild_merchant.community_expectation: Bargaining once daily is a common guild requirement, not just a personal tool.
guild_merchant.bargain_vs_donation: Bargain and donation are DIFFERENT systems and are commonly confused. DONATIONS are in the main guild tab: 5 per day, first free then 20/40/60/80 gems, and they level the guild up. BARGAIN is its own section in the guild menu: one rotating item per day whose gem price the whole guild collectively drives down. Contributing to one does nothing for the other.
guild_merchant.bargain_contribution_size: Each member's Bargain automatically takes a small amount off the day's item price for everyone — roughly 5% of the price per bargain. The cut applies to the whole guild, not just to the member who bargained.
guild_merchant.buy_early_or_wait: There is NO advantage to waiting for the guild to finish bargaining before you buy. If you buy at the higher price and the guild then bargains it lower, the difference is returned to you in gems by mail the next day. The only real difference is how many gems you need up front on the day itself.

guild_aid.overview: A Mystling-specific member help system. Guildmates can speed up each other's Pact Sanctum upgrade timers and Mystling egg hatch times.
guild_aid.upgrades: The Mystling Collection track has milestones that improve it: 'Guild assist reward chances +N' boosts what you earn from helping others, and 'Assisted help requests: extra -60s' makes assistance you receive more impactful.
guild_aid.routine: Sending and receiving Guild Aid daily is part of an active member's loop, especially in guilds focused on Mystling progression.

guild.guild_coins_source: Guild Coins (used in the Guild Store) come from Monster Invasion guild ranking rewards and guild donation rewards. Consistent Monster Invasion damage plus donating to Guild Research is the loop that funds Guild Store purchases.
guild.daily_routine: A typical active guild day: claim Pact Sanctum if upgraded, run Monster Invasion (Quick-Raid if you own the Sealing Master card), place 1 Bargain at Guild Merchant, buy daily hero shards from the Guild Store, contribute to Guild Research, and deploy/battle in Guild Expedition during active rounds.
guild.why_it_matters: Active guild membership is essential for endgame progression — Monster Invasion rewards, Guild Expedition coins, daily merchant bargains, hero shard farming, and guild-wide research buffs all require active participation.
guild.open_questions: Not documented in this contribution: what Manage Member reveals, how Expedition Hearts are earned, and the full league ladder above and below Thunderbound Oath.

requirements.overview: The Arch 2 Addicts community runs two Archero 2 guilds. Both carry the same activity standards; only the power minimum differs. Set by XYIAN, effective 2026-08-24.
requirements.xyian_official_power: XYIAN OFFICIAL (Guild ID 213797), the founding guild, requires 8M+ power.
requirements.projectxy_power: ProjectXY (Guild ID 214890), the sister guild and the primary home for new members, requires 6M+ power.
requirements.shared_activity: Both guilds require the same activity: daily Monster Invasion (the guild boss battle, called MI) and guild research at 2x minimum per day; daily guild donations at 2x minimum per day; and being active in Discord. The donation minimum is 2 rather than 1 because the first donation of the day is free, so a single donation costs nothing and proves nothing.
requirements.why_two_guilds: XYIAN OFFICIAL filled up, so ProjectXY was created as a sister guild in August 2026. One community, one Discord, and a deliberate commitment not to expand past a single sub-guild.

starlight_gala.overview: Starlight Gala is a weekly guild feature — 'Who's the guild's brightest star this week?' Winners are picked from each member's activity and contribution over the past week, receiving a range of honor awards, and one member is named guild MVP. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
starlight_gala.how_winners_are_chosen: Winners are picked from each member's activity and contribution over the PAST week: a range of honor awards is given out, and one member is named guild MVP. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
starlight_gala.during_the_event: During the gala you can watch the award ceremony, send emotes to join in, claim rewards, and review records from past galas. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
starlight_gala.name: The official name is Starlight Gala. The in-game Update Preview of 23 Aug 2026 called this same feature the 'Guild Starlight Celebration' — a superseded preview name for one feature, not a second event. Always call it the Starlight Gala.

gear_sets.godforge: On Godforge, you will need Gear Essence and Crystals to upgrade your gear. You need to salvage any gear (excluding S-tier) to get Gear Essence and you also need to salvage the corresponding S-tier set pieces to get Crystals. You can only salvage S-tier pieces that you have already on Chaotic lvl.
gear_sets.overview: Six core gear sets: three base sets and three S-Ranked counterparts. Only S-Ranked gear can be upgraded past Legendary.
gear_sets.gear_slots: Six gear slots per hero: Helmet, Armor, Weapon, Boots, Ring, Amulet.
gear_sets.loadouts: Every player has 8 saved loadouts they can name and configure freely. Loadouts are player-level slots, not hero-level — they persist independent of which hero is selected.

set_pairs.destruction: Base set, caps at Legendary. S-Ranked counterpart: Dragoon.
set_pairs.decisiveness: Base set, caps at Legendary. S-Ranked counterpart: Griffin.
set_pairs.echo: Base set, caps at Legendary. S-Ranked counterpart: Oracle.

gear_sets.s_ranked_indicator: S-Ranked pieces show a yellow 'S' badge on the gear icon (it can read as a '5' at small sizes).
gear_sets.s_ranked_source: S-Ranked gear (Dragoon / Griffin / Oracle) drops directly from Mythstone Chest and Chromatic Chest. You do not build them up from base set pieces.
gear_sets.s_ranked_minimum_rarity: S-Ranked gear never drops at Common, Fine, or Rare. The lowest rarity an S-Ranked piece can drop at is Epic; from there it can be upgraded to Chaotic.
gear_sets.rarity_ladder_note: 14 rarity tiers, low to high, ending at Chaotic.
gear_sets.base_set_cap: Base sets (Destruction / Decisiveness / Echo) can be upgraded through Legendary +3 but cannot reach Mythic or beyond.
gear_sets.s_ranked_cap: S-Ranked sets (Dragoon / Griffin / Oracle) can be upgraded all the way to Chaotic.
gear_sets.base_set_fodder: Past early game, base set pieces have no long-term upgrade ceiling, so most players use them as upgrade fodder for S-Ranked pieces.
gear_sets.gear_levels: Each gear piece has a Level counter from 1 to 200, upgraded with slot-specific Gear Scrolls (Weapon Scroll for weapons, Armor Scroll for armor, etc.).
gear_sets.gear_scroll_sources: Gear Scrolls drop from Hunt and are sold in the Daily Shop and as Reach milestone rewards.
gear_sets.levels_vs_rarity: Gear level and rarity are independent progression tracks. Level grows to 200 via Gear Scrolls; rarity is upgraded separately at the Blacksmith. They do not affect each other.
gear_sets.upgrade_costs: Rarity upgrades cost Gold plus slot-specific Scrolls.
gear_sets.piece_detail_fields: A gear piece's detail screen shows name + rarity tier, level X/200, Skin Skills (set-specific abilities) and Quality Skills (stat bonuses).
gear_sets.stat_snapshot_caveat: Per-piece stats below were captured at the Chaotic rarity tier. Lower rarities show a subset of these effects, and flat values scale with the piece's level.

weapon_skins.scope: Skins exist only for the main weapon. There are no skins for Helmet, Armor, Boots, Ring, or Amulet. Only one weapon skin can be equipped at a time.
weapon_skins.weapon_archetypes: Three base weapon archetypes, each with multiple skins: Crossbow (Heroic Longbow family), Staff (Beam Staff family), and Claw (Agile Knuckles / Griffin Claw family).
weapon_skins.two_layers: Each skin has two layers with different activation rules: Collectible Stats and Skin Skills.
weapon_skins.collectible_stats: Static and always active once you own the skin, whether or not it is equipped. Owning more skins stacks their Collectible Stats permanently across the account.
weapon_skins.skin_skills: Only active while that skin is equipped. The active ability proc (Snowball, Lacerate DoT, Cudgel Jab, summoned hoops, etc.) only triggers on the currently equipped skin.
weapon_skins.star_upgrades: Every skin has 6 effective tiers: an 'owned' baseline (0 stars) plus 1 star through 5 stars. You upgrade only by acquiring duplicate skins — each duplicate is one star. There is no currency-based upgrade path.
weapon_skins.star_benefits: Higher stars give stronger Collectible Stats (bigger per-piece-equipped bonuses) and stronger Skin Skills (more damage, procs, and stacks).
weapon_skins.skin_rarity: Skins have their own rarities; icon background color is a tell (purple-magenta = lower, gold-yellow = higher). Higher-rarity skins give bigger Collectible Stats at every star tier. More rarity tiers exist beyond these two, with different ratios; the full ladder was not captured.

collectible_stats_gold_rarity.note: Per matching-set gear piece equipped, for higher-rarity (gold icon) skins such as Holly Blitz, Cosmic Hoop, Monarch's Fang.

collectible_stats_purple_rarity.note: Per matching-set gear piece equipped, for lower-rarity (purple icon) skins such as Shadesteal Claw.

weapon_skins.set_tie: Each skin is tied to a specific gear set (Griffin / Dragoon / Oracle). Its Collectible Stats only count matching-set gear — equipping a Griffin skin while wearing Oracle gear means the Collectible Stats have nothing to count.
weapon_skins.acquisition: Hero Skin Shop is the primary source; Reforger Shop is an alternative source/exchange. The skin tooltip header reads 'Skin Exchange Shop'.
weapon_skins.strategy: Two different priorities: Collectible Stats reward breadth (owning many skins, even at low stars, builds a permanent passive power floor), while Skin Skills reward depth (level your best equipped skin to 5 stars via duplicates).

runes.overview: Runes provide stat bonuses, starting skills and special passives. They equip to a fixed set of slots arranged around the active hero.

equip_slots.new_player_gating: Etched Rune slots #2 and #3 are locked until the player reaches certain rune-level thresholds. Slot #1 is available from the start.
equip_slots.loadouts: The Runes screen shares the same 8 loadouts as Gear, via a dropdown at top right.

category_roles.ability_runes: Grant Starting Skills - active in-run abilities (procs and summoned units). Without them the hero has only main-weapon attacks plus their unique kit.
category_roles.enhancement_runes: Amplify a specific theme. They do not grant starting skills; they reshape how a theme behaves once active. Higher base stats than Ability Runes (ATK PWR +950 / +1,200 vs +50 on a comparable Ability Rune).
category_roles.blessing_runes: Passive run-modifiers (luck, dodge, conversion, revive). They shift probabilities, enable safety nets or convert stats. With only 2 slots this is one of the highest-leverage build decisions.
category_roles.etched_runes: High-power category amplifiers that lock in build identity. Substantially higher base stats (e.g. ATK PWR +1,200 vs +50 on a comparable Ability Rune). They multiply what your Ability Runes produce rather than granting Starting Skills.

themes.count: 7 themes: Circle, Main Weapon, Sword Strike, Meteor, Elemental, Plant, Sprite.
themes.scope: All Ability, Enhancement and Etched Runes fall into one of the 7 themes. Blessing Runes sit outside this categorization.
themes.why_it_matters: Promised Ruins targets by theme; Etched Runes amplify by theme (a Sprite Etched Rune only multiplies Sprite-themed runes); strategic builds align all 4 Ability + 4 Enhancement + 3 Etched runes around 1-3 themes.
themes.group_split_note: The Group A / Group B split of the 7 themes exists only as the Promised Ruins selection mechanic. Outside that screen the themes are flat.

rarity_ladder.order: Common, Fine, Rare, Epic, Epic +1, Epic +2, Legendary, Legendary +1, Legendary +2, Legendary +3, Mythic (max).
rarity_ladder.differs_from_gear: Runes cap at Mythic - no Chaotic tier and no Mythic + variants, unlike gear.
rarity_ladder.f2p_outlook: Mythic runes are realistically reachable for F2P but take a long time accumulating duplicates from Hunt drops, Rune Ruins, Promised Ruins and free chests. Legendary +3 on key runes is a comfortable mid-term F2P goal; Mythic is long-term.

stat_unlock_mechanics.one_stat_per_tier: Each named rarity tier unlocks one new stat line, shown on the detail screen as a colour-dotted row.
stat_unlock_mechanics.dot_tiers: Dots represent only the 6 named tiers: Common, Fine, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic. A lock icon means not yet unlocked.
stat_unlock_mechanics.plus_variants: Epic +1/+2 and Legendary +1/+2/+3 sit between the named tiers. On Ability, Enhancement and Blessing Runes they add no new rows - they amplify existing effect values and bump the cumulative primary stat.
stat_unlock_mechanics.primary_stat_row: The top row shows the cumulative primary stat (knife icon = ATK PWR, heart icon = Max HP), which scales through every tier including the + variants and Mythic.
stat_unlock_mechanics.enchantment_unlock_position: The Enchantment slot unlocks at Epic +2, between the Epic and Legendary dots, so it is not a dot row; it appears as a separate section at the bottom of the rune detail screen.
stat_unlock_mechanics.locked_row_reading: Lock colour indicates the tier band: a yellow lock is the Legendary band (L, L+1, L+2, L+3 - 4 rows, top-to-bottom in that order), a red lock is Mythic (1 row). Locked text stays readable.

unlock_counts_by_category.ability_runes: 6 unlocks total, one per named tier. + variants only bump the cumulative primary stat.
unlock_counts_by_category.enhancement_runes: 6 unlocks total, same as Ability. + variants are stat-value bumps only.
unlock_counts_by_category.blessing_runes: 4 unlocks total (Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic). Common and Fine are absorbed into the cumulative ATK PWR + Max HP shown at the top of the detail screen.
unlock_counts_by_category.etched_runes: Up to 9 unlocks total - the 6 named tiers plus additional buff lines at Legendary +1, +2 and +3. Unique to Etched Runes; these L+ variants meaningfully grow the rune's kit, not just its numbers.
unlock_counts_by_category.mythic_is_terminal: Mythic is the top tier: final unlock, max stat values, no further upgrades.

runes.blessing_rune_primary_stats: Blessing Runes show two primary stats. At Legendary +2 each displays roughly ATK PWR +570 and Max HP +2,280 as baseline cumulative stats.

enchantment_system.applies_to: Ability, Enhancement and Blessing Runes only. Etched Runes do NOT have an Enchantment slot - they only have an Equip button.
enchantment_system.unlock: Unlocked at Epic +2 per rune (each rune individually must reach Epic +2), not account-wide.
enchantment_system.archive: Each rune has an Enchantment Archive - a pool of possible Enchantment Stats organised into categories specific to the rune type.
enchantment_system.one_at_a_time: Only ONE Enchantment can be equipped at a time per rune.
enchantment_system.how_to_change: Use the Enchant button on a rune to open the Enchantizer screen and swap which Enchantment Stat is active.
enchantment_system.placeholder_text: Until a selection is made after the Epic +2 unlock, the line displays the placeholder 'Unlocks Rune Enchantment'.
enchantment_system.progression_bar: A progression bar at the bottom of the Enchantizer (observed at 21/100) tracks toward additional Archive entries.
enchantment_system.quality_range: Each Archive entry has its own rarity, Common through Mythic, determined by the pull. The Specialized category is always Legendary or Mythic, never lower.
enchantment_system.archive_rule: In-game Rule 3: the affix archive stores unlocked affix types of the highest quality. They can be freely switched in unlocked rune slots and saved as different presets.
enchantment_system.archive_keeps_best: The Archive remembers only the highest-quality version of each affix ever pulled. A later Mythic replaces an earlier Legendary of the same affix.
enchantment_system.free_switching: Once an affix is in the Archive you can freely switch among entries with no re-rolling.
enchantment_system.presets: Presets can be saved per rune slot, e.g. one for boss fights and one for crowd clear.
enchantment_system.obtained_label: The 'Obtained' label next to an affix in the Rules popup means that affix is already in your Archive.

enchantment_categories.blessing_runes: 9 categories: ATK PWR; Max HP; Reduced Circle DMG taken; Reduced Sword Strike DMG taken; Reduced Sprite DMG taken; Reduced Main Weapon DMG taken; Reduced Meteor DMG taken; Reduced Elemental DMG taken; Specialized. Categories 1-8 roll Common to Mythic; Specialized always rolls Legendary or Mythic and is rune-specific.
enchantment_categories.enhancement_runes: 7 categories: ATK PWR; [Theme] DMG (varies by rune theme); Boss DMG; More damage VS minions; [Theme] CRIT Rate; CRIT DMG; Specialized. Categories 1-6 roll Common to Mythic; Specialized always rolls Legendary or Mythic.
enchantment_categories.ability_runes: 7 categories: Max HP; Elemental DMG; Boss DMG REDUC; Minion DMG REDUC; Elemental CRIT DMG; CRIT DMG REDUC; Specialized. Categories 1-6 roll Common to Mythic; Specialized always rolls Legendary or Mythic.
enchantment_categories.ability_vs_enhancement: Ability Rune enchantments skew defensive and elemental (Max HP, REDUC stats); Enhancement skews offensive (ATK PWR, DMG bumps). Both have 7 categories with Specialized as the 7th.
enchantment_categories.open_question: Source flags as unverified whether 'Elemental DMG' and 'Elemental CRIT DMG' on Ability Runes are literal or theme-flexible (e.g. whether Plant Summon shows 'Plant DMG' instead).
enchantment_categories.specialized_strategy: Specialized is the only Blessing enchantment guaranteed Legendary+ and is uniquely tailored to that rune, so a Mythic Specialized roll is generally the strongest enchantment outcome.
enchantment_categories.specialized_coverage: Every Ability, Enhancement and Blessing Rune has its own unique Mythic Specialized Enchantment. The source documents all 7 Blessing ones and 2 of 13 Enhancement ones (Sharp Arrow, Frostshock Seal); the remaining 11 Enhancement and all 13 Ability Specialized enchantments are undocumented.

enchantizer_currencies.enchantium: Standard Enchantizer pull currency (green triangle with arrowhead icon).
enchantizer_currencies.advanced_enchantium: Advanced Enchantizer pull currency (pink circle with arrowhead icon). Much rarer than standard Enchantium.
enchantizer_currencies.gems: The standard top-bar gem currency. Convertible into Enchantium, but the enchanting cost itself is paid in Enchantium - gems and Enchantium are different currencies.
enchantizer_currencies.gem_to_enchantium_rate: The gem cost per Enchantium batch escalates with attempts made that day: 300 gems/attempt for the 21st-30th purchase, 400 gems/attempt for the 31st-40th, with further escalation likely above.
enchantizer_currencies.daily_reset: The gem cost ladder resets daily, so heavy converters should spread purchases across days rather than burning them in one sitting.

standard_enchantizer.mechanic: Each attempt rolls 3 random Enchantments from the rune's eligible affix pool, shown in a slot-machine-style 3-row UI. You choose one to equip or skip and re-roll.
standard_enchantizer.skip_toggle: When the Skip toggle is on, the machine auto-rolls past Common/Fine/Rare results.
standard_enchantizer.auto_enchant: Holding the Enchant button repeats pulls automatically and pauses on any Legendary or Mythic result (in-game Rule 2).
standard_enchantizer.anti_dup_rule: When enchanting runes of the same type, identical Mythic affixes will not be drawn - Mythic dupes are filtered.
standard_enchantizer.practical_rate: Roughly 1 in 400 standard pulls is Mythic.
standard_enchantizer.mythic_specialized_rate: Pulling a Mythic Specialized via the Standard Enchantizer is roughly 1 in 1,667 pulls.

advanced_enchantizer.pity_counter: A 'Get Mythic affix in N draws' counter guarantees a Mythic affix within a rolling pity window (observed at 3 draws).
advanced_enchantizer.mechanic: Same 3-row slot machine, Skip toggle and auto-enchant rules as the standard Enchantizer, with dramatically better odds.

drop_rates.epic: ~70% cumulative (source flags exact % as needing verification)

advanced_enchantizer.practical_rate: Roughly 1 in 9 Advanced pulls is Mythic, versus 1 in 400 standard.
advanced_enchantizer.earning_advanced_enchantium: 1 Advanced Enchantium per 100 standard Enchant pulls - the 21/100 counter at the bottom of the standard Enchantizer tracks this. That is 100,000 Enchantium spent per 1 Advanced Enchantium earned.
advanced_enchantizer.direct_purchase: Advanced Enchantium can also be bought directly; store details undocumented in source.
advanced_enchantizer.strategic_note: The Advanced Enchantizer's 11% Mythic rate plus its pity counter is what makes endgame Enchantments feasible. F2P accumulate Advanced Enchantium slowly.

rune_workshop.purpose: Fuse/merge owned runes to produce a single higher-rarity rune.
rune_workshop.warehouse: The Warehouse view shows all available (non-equipped) runes.
rune_workshop.quick_fuse: Quick Fuse auto-selects optimal fusion candidates.
rune_workshop.result: The Fusion successful popup shows the result rune name, new rarity, a stat preview (old to new) and any newly unlocked stat lines.
rune_workshop.equipped_excluded: Equipped runes are excluded from fusion and show an 'Equipped' overlay.

rune_ruins.dig_x1: Costs 1 Ruin Shovel, or falls back to Gems.
rune_ruins.auto_dig: Hold down to auto-dig for batch digs.
rune_ruins.drop_rate_example: Rusty Chest, excluding the minimum guarantee: overall rate 28.80% at the rune tier - 15 individual runes at 1.11% each, then more at 0.31% / 0.30% / 0.15% for rarer items. Higher-tier chests follow the same structure with higher rarity floors.

promised_ruins.purpose: Same chest framework as Rune Ruins but category-targeted.
promised_ruins.selection_rule: You pick ONE category from EACH of the two groups (not 'or'), so every dig is guaranteed to draw from both selections.
promised_ruins.group_a: Pick one of: Circle, Main Weapon, Sword Strike.
promised_ruins.group_b: Pick one of: Meteor, Elemental, Plant, Sprite.
promised_ruins.when_to_use: Use Promised Ruins when building toward two specific themes; use Rune Ruins when fishing broadly.

rune_packs.daily_special_pack: Refreshes every 24h. 6 packs ranging from 499 Aurocite up to $49.99 USD, all flagged '400% Value'.
rune_packs.weekly_special_pack: Refreshes weekly, with additional packs at higher price points.
rune_packs.typical_contents: Gems, gold, ruin shovels, relic shovels, runes directly, and rune-related upgrade materials.

sources_summary.hunt: Best for bulk passive runes. Cost: free / energy / ad.
sources_summary.rune_ruins: Best for random rune fishing. Cost: Ruin Shovels or Gems.
sources_summary.promised_ruins: Best for targeted theme runes. Cost: Relic Shovels or Gems (300+).
sources_summary.packs: Paid bundles with mixed contents. Cost: Aurocite or USD.
sources_summary.rune_workshop: Upgrades rarity rather than granting new runes. Cost: existing duplicate runes.

build_patterns.principle: You equip 4 Ability + 4 Enhancement runes simultaneously. Ability Runes give the building blocks (starting skills, summons, procs); Enhancement Runes amplify and reshape how those skills behave. Match Etched Runes to your equipped Ability Runes.
build_patterns.sprite_build: 2x Sprite Ability (Melee Sprite, Healing Sprite) + 2x Sprite Enhancement (Sprite Multishot, Sprite Link) + Sprite Etched (Sprite Assist, Sprite's Awe).
build_patterns.circle_build: 2x Circle Ability (Circle, Ring of Agony) + 2x Circle Enhancement (Sawblade Circle, Spin SPD Up) + Circle Etched (Pulsing Orb, Orbital Orb).
build_patterns.plant_build: Plant Summon + Equinox Bloom + Rootguard + Vine Bind + Life Surge.
build_patterns.meteor_build: Star of Time + Star of Fury + Potion Magnet + Giant Meteor + Meteor Split / Potion Spring.
build_patterns.etched_slots_declare_identity: With only 3 Etched slots, your Etched Runes essentially declare which 3 categories the build leans on. Multi-category builds spread them thinner.

runes._coverage: Source catalogues 13 Ability, 13 Enhancement, 7 Blessing and 13 Etched Runes, and notes more Etched Runes likely exist beyond those documented.

game_modes.overview: There are four main game-mode categories: Campaign, Arena, Challenge, and Dungeon. Each contains sub-modes with different mechanics and rewards.

campaign.overview: Campaign is the main PvE mode where you fight against computer enemies. It is vastly different from PvP — bonuses, gear rankings, and strategies change drastically between the two.
campaign.farming_drops: To optimize gear, runes, and scroll drops: choose campaign levels that have 50 floors, not the 6-minute or endless versions. 50-floor runs have 5 boss battles (one every 10th floor), so more boss drops per run. 6-minute or endless runs have only 2 boss battles total, so fewer drops per run.
campaign.fifty_floor_types: There are two types of 50-floor campaign levels. One type requires walking through a door to change floors each time. The other type uses the same map for all 50 floors — e.g. Serenity Pool — so you never have to move; you can leave your character in one spot and farm easily. Same-map 50-floor levels like Serenity Pool are ideal for farming.
campaign.profile_exp_note: Campaign is the only way to earn profile experience. See profile_experience category.
campaign.hard_mode_note: Later campaign levels introduce hard-mode mechanics that require Sky Tower progression to unlock (e.g. campaign 126 requires Sky Tower 1525 cleared).
campaign.hard_vs_heroic_naming: Hard Mode and Heroic Mode are TWO NAMES FOR THE SAME campaign track — the harder second track that runs alongside the Normal Mode chapters. Chapter numbering is one continuous sequence across both names: update 1.1.7 added 166-175 and the 2026-08-23 update added 176-185. A question about 'Heroic chapter N' and 'Hard chapter N' means the same stage.
campaign.stage_ranges_august_2026: The August 2026 hotfix adds Campaign (Normal) stages 191-200 and Hard stages 176-185. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
campaign.difficulty_reductions: Two SEPARATE difficulty reductions, both true and neither replacing the other: update 1.1.7 lowered the difficulty of campaign stages after Chapter 80, and the August 2026 hotfix lowered it for campaign stages after Chapter 130.
campaign.track_name_mapping: The official patch notes call the two tracks 'Campaign Stages' and 'Hard Stages'. These are the same two tracks recorded elsewhere as Main Chapters and Heroic Chapters: Campaign = Main = Normal Mode, and Hard = Heroic.

arena.overview: Arena is the PvP category. Sub-modes: Main Arena, Peak Arena, Rumble Ladder, All-Star Cup, and Mega All-Star Cup.
arena.main_arena: The main arena has multiple tiers (Supreme is the top). Standard 1v1 PvP.
arena.peak_arena: Peak Arena is a 3v3 mode where you use three of your own characters against three of your opponent's. You pick separate loadouts for each character. If each character has unique/different gear and runes (e.g. one Circle build, one Meteor build, one Sprite build), you get a large bonus (~25% ATK and HP). Duplicate loadouts across characters give little to no bonus — the game rewards variety.
arena.rumble_ladder: Rumble Ladder is a PvP ladder mode.
arena.all_star_cup: All Star Cup is one of the most recent PvP additions. Each season lasts about 12 days and features different bonuses for different runes and loadouts. Depending on the current season's bonuses and your loadout, you could dominate or struggle — adapting your build to the season's modifiers is key. When selecting a start time, Habby made the time slots actually localized for players.
arena.main_arena_tiers: 6 tiers, low to high. Bronze: 50 players per group, top 15 promoted. Gold: 100 per group, top 30 promoted, bottom 40 demoted. Diamond: 200 per group, top 20 promoted, bottom 100 demoted. Master: no group limit, top 20% promoted, bottom 40% demoted. Transcendent: no limit, top 20% promoted, bottom 40% demoted. Supreme: top tier, no promotion possible - the top 40% keep their tier and the rest are demoted.
arena.main_arena_settlement: Weekly settlement. If a group holds fewer players than expected, results are assigned in priority order: same-ranked players, then promoted players, then demoted players. The in-game example is a 45-player group where 20 first stay at the same rank, then the top 20 are promoted, then the last 5 are demoted.
arena.main_arena_promotion_note: The source's own summary table also states 'Top 46 promote at season settlement', which does not line up with the per-tier promotion rules it lists elsewhere. Recorded as written; unresolved.
arena.arena_shop: Spends Arena Coins (red icon). Phynx Shard 5,400, Nezha Shard 5,400, Random Epic Enhancement Rune 20,250, Random Epic Ability Rune 20,250, Random Epic Blessing Rune 30,750, Obsidian Chest Key 45,000, Chromatic Chest Key 60,000, Wish Coin 60,000, Ruin Shovel 15,000. Daily limits: 38 for Phynx Shard, 10 for everything else.
arena.arena_shop_exclusives: Phynx and Nezha (Epic hero) shards are sold only in the Arena Shop, so Arena is the primary path for those two heroes' shards. The Guild Store carries Rare hero shards only.
arena.peak_arena_rules: Active skin skills of deployed characters DO take effect, but Resonance skills do NOT. Each deployed character can be equipped with gear and runes, and gear and runes can be reused across the three characters - you do not need to own multiple sets.
arena.peak_arena_tickets: Each challenge costs 1 Peak Arena Ticket. Tickets refill periodically (observed 1 ticket per 3h 06m) and can be bought with gems; purchases reset daily. When a season ends, all excess tickets above the cap are removed, so do not stockpile tickets at season end.
arena.peak_arena_hours: Runs daily 0:00-23:50 UTC+0, with a short downtime at the end of the UTC day.
arena.power_of_fusion: Peak Arena's diversity bonus. Grants every deployed character Final ATK and Final HP equal to [Stacks x 1%]. Stacks come from: each unique character beyond the first, +10; each unique gear piece beyond 6 across all deployed characters, +8; each unique Rune beyond 13 across all deployed characters, +6; each full Godforged Star on a deployed character's gear, +3 (for duplicate gear only the highest Godforge star counts).
arena.peak_arena_strategy: Power of Fusion rewards breadth of collection - 3 different characters with different gear, runes and high Godforge stars. This is the opposite of 1v1 Arena, which uses a single loadout.
arena.peak_arena_ranking: A new season starts with no rank; you must win at least 1 battle to be ranked. Ranks display as a stair-step structure. Daily rewards cap at 2 claims per day.
arena.peak_arena_shop: Spends Peak Arena Coins (yellow star icon); the rotation refreshes roughly every 2 days, in sync with the seasonal cycle. Observed: Loki Shard 360 (50 purchases), Character Shadows 70 (200), Swapping Orb 1,200 at 50% off (2), Enchantium x1,000 for 200 at 50% off (50), plus cosmetics Starry Eyes 4,000, Heart Eyes 4,000, Angel Halo 2,000 at 50% off, Floating Bracelet 2,000 at 50% off, Fiery Wings 40,000, Fireworks 40,000 (1 purchase each).
arena.peak_arena_shop_notes: Loki (Epic hero) shards are exclusive to the Peak Arena Shop. Character Shadows at 70 coins are an efficient Sacred Hall feeder, and the discounted Enchantium pack effectively converts Peak Arena coins into rune Enchantment progression.
arena.rumble_modes: Two sub-modes. Rumble Dome: ATK and HP scale with your current power. Free-for-All: everyone uses default ATK and HP, and only appearance and Rumble-specific skills are inherited, so gear and runes create no power gap - a pure skill match.
arena.rumble_map: Storage Zone: deliver carried gifts here to score points. Trap Zone: contains traps, and gift barrels refresh every 30 seconds. Boss Zone: 1 boss spawns every 30 seconds, the first after 30s.
arena.rumble_skills: You play your own owned characters and each character has unique Rumble skills. Skills acquired during battle do not interrupt the skill panel - it stays open and skills can be selected at any time; if none are selected, new skills queue.
arena.rumble_trophies: Trophies are counted separately for each character and rise or fall on that character's own performance plus match placement. Your ranking total is the sum of your top 3 characters' trophies. Matchmaking prioritises players of similar rank using the multiplayer Cred Score system.
arena.rumble_schedule: Free-For-All Rumble runs Mon-Wed only, in four 3-hour windows per day, all UTC+0: 1:00-4:00, 7:00-10:00, 13:00-16:00 and 19:00-22:00. That is about 12 hours a day and 36 hours per week.
arena.rumble_tiers: Rumble Dome is one named tier (trophy range 500-549 observed). Tier gem rewards recorded for Rumble Dome: trophies 10-19 give 240 gems, 30-39 give 400, 40-49 give 400. The 20-29 and 50-59 rows were not captured, and tier names above Rumble Dome are unknown.
arena.rumble_shop: Spends Rumble Tokens (yellow trophy icon). Observed: Random Epic Enhancement Rune 1,350 (3 purchases left), Random Epic Ability Rune 1,350 (3), Universal Rare Artifact Shard 75 (30), Ruin Shovel 100 at 50% off (10) or 200 full price (50), Chromatic Chest Key 400 (50), Wish Coin 400 (50), Gold x50 for 1 (9,999). Sold out at snapshot: Random S/Epic Gear, Random Rare Character, Universal Epic and Universal Legendary Artifact Shards, and the discounted Chromatic Chest Key and Wish Coin.
arena.rumble_shop_notes: Rumble Shop is a strong all-round store - Random Rare Character and Random S/Epic Gear are variety the Guild, Arena and Peak shops do not offer. The 50-60% discounts are time-limited. Universal Rare Artifact Shards at 75 tokens are cheap enough to buy in bulk.
arena.all_star_cup_stages: Qualifiers: open competition ranked on floors reached plus stage clear time; the top 64 advance. Elimination Stage: the 64 split into 8 groups of 8, and the top of each group advances, leaving 8 finalists. Finals: the 8 finalists face off head to head and the winner is crowned All-Star Cup Champion.
arena.all_star_cup_guessing: During the Elimination Stage and Finals players can wager Guess Coins on match outcomes. A successful guess pays 1.5x the wagered Guess Coins back in All-Star Cup tokens.
arena.all_star_cup_shop: Spends All-Star Cup Tokens (yellow star icon). Observed: Random Epic Enhancement Rune 6,750 (2 purchases), Random Epic Ability Rune 6,750 (2), Random Epic Blessing Rune 10,125 (2), Universal Rare Artifact Shard 375 (30), Universal Epic Artifact Shard 1,125 (20), Universal Legendary Artifact Shard 2,250 (10), Chromatic Chest Key 1,600 at 50% off (5) or 2,000 full price (20), Ruin Shovel 800 at 50% off (5) or 1,000 full price (20), Wish Coin 1,600 at 50% off (5) or 2,000 full price (20), Enchantium x1,000 for 2,000 (20), Gold x10 for 1 (9,999). Rare Character Universal Shard was sold out.
arena.all_star_cup_shop_exclusives: Universal Artifact Shards are unique to the All-Star Cup shop - high-value cross-rarity items not available elsewhere. Worth prioritising if you run All-Star Cup actively.
arena.all_star_cup_seasons: Themes change every season (Sword Strike at snapshot, next theme unknown). Build a Preset loadout aligned to the active theme for tournament viability.
arena.main_arena_mechanics: 1v1 ranked PvP ladder on weekly seasons that settle and reset on a 7-day cycle. Challenge attempts are limited (snapshot showed 'Challenge x1', apparently daily-restored). Runs one of your 8 saved preset loadouts. The screen header is named after your current tier, e.g. 'Transcendent Battle'.
arena.peak_arena_mechanics: PvP mode where each player dispatches 3 characters to attack or defend; duplicate characters are allowed. Weekly seasons. The Peak1 / Peak2 / Peak3 loadout slots in the gear system exist for this mode.
arena.rumble_ladder_mechanics: 6-player free-for-all PvP survival, run in periodic seasons (Off-Season at snapshot). Matches last 3 minutes: collect EXP to gain power, defeat monsters to earn gifts, and deliver gifts to storage zones to score points, competing for top rank inside the 3 minutes.
arena.all_star_cup_mechanics: Periodic 3-stage tournament with themed seasons (Sword Strike Season at snapshot). You must have reached Campaign Chapter 15 to take part in any cycle. Servers are grouped into zones by launch schedule and estimated participant count to balance competition.
arena.starlight_cup_is_all_star_cup: Starlight Cup IS the All-Star Cup: a PvP tournament, NOT the Starlight Gala guild event — they only share the word 'Starlight'. 'Starlight Cup' and 'Super Starlight Cup' were preview names for All-Star Cup and Mega All-Star Cup. Answer any Starlight Cup question from the All-Star Cup entries, never from the Gala's.
arena.all_star_cup_vs_starlight_gala: All-Star Cup is a PvP tournament; the Starlight Gala is a guild event. They are different things that both contain 'Star' — do not merge them, and do not describe one using the other's rules.
arena.all_star_cup_battle_changes: In All-Star Cup and Mega All-Star Cup, Boss death animations no longer play and the stage timer pauses while you are selecting a Boss. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
arena.all_star_cup_qualifier_scaling: All-Star Cup qualifier monster strength is now scaled by server group. All-Star Cup already groups servers into zones by launch schedule and estimated participant count. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
arena.mega_all_star_cup: Mega All-Star Cup is named in the official patch notes (28 Aug 2026) alongside All-Star Cup and receives the same battle change. Nothing else is documented — what it is, how you enter it, what it rewards, and whether it is a separate mode or a higher tier of All-Star Cup are all unrecorded. Say so plainly and point at !suggest.
arena.arena_shop_promised_ruin_shovel: The Promised Ruin Shovel was added to the Arena Shop in this update; its price and daily limit were not given. The arena_shop item list here predates that addition. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
arena.starlight_cup_mapping_basis: That mapping is an inference, not a stated one: both sources describe the identical pair of changes in the same update, and the official notes never mention a Starlight Cup. The same preview also said 'Sword Intent' for Sword Will and 'Guild Starlight Celebration' for Starlight Gala.

challenge.overview: Challenge modes: Sky Tower, Seal Battle, and Magic Plant Defense.
challenge.sky_tower: Sky Tower is linked to campaign progression. It unlocks higher campaign levels — for example, campaign level 126 requires clearing Sky Tower 1525. Sky Tower gates what campaign content you can access, usually becoming relevant around campaign level 50+.
challenge.seal_battle: Seal Battle is a boss battle mode where the goal is to deal the most damage to a boss.
challenge.magic_plant_defense: Magic Plant Defense is a newer mode where you defend a magic plant across different levels. Max level is 195 until you clear Campaign Mode 140, which unlocks levels up to 250. Use all your plant defense eggs each week — if you're over a certain threshold you do NOT get the 3 tickets replenished.
challenge.magic_plant_defense_stages: New stages unlock based on campaign progress. In co-op both players must have the stage unlocked, so you cannot carry a lower-progression friend into a stage they have not reached.
challenge.magic_plant_defense_rewards: Clear rewards include Mystling Eggs and Mystling materials, making it the primary source for hatching new Mystlings. Drops vary by stage and higher stages drop better. In co-op the host's drop rates apply and assisting players get reduced rates.
challenge.magic_plant_defense_drop_rates: Drop rates from the in-game rules, observed at Stage 191: blue gem item 70.00%, purple gem item 24.00%, yellow item 6.00%. Rates scale upward by stage. The rules popup has separate Rules and Drop Rate tabs.
challenge.magic_plant_defense_mystlings: Defending the magic plant uses your deployed Mystlings, which is why the mode also appears inside Camp.
challenge.magic_plant_defense_shop: The Exchange Shop spends MPD Tokens (orange flower icon) earned from defending stages and refreshes every 2d 06h. Observed: Random Gear Scroll 20 (200 purchases), Wish Coin 800 (5), Enchantium x1,000 for 800 (10), Gold x25 for 1 (9,999), Thorned Crown 10,000 (1), Shadow Path 20,000 (1), Divine Tree Totem 80,000 (1), Magic Plant Spirit 80,000 (1). Spirit Pact Seed was sold out at snapshot.
challenge.magic_plant_defense_spirit_pact_seed: The Magic Plant Defense exchange shop is a confirmed source of Spirit Pact Seeds, the material used to upgrade the Pact Sanctum in Camp.
challenge.seal_battle_seasons: A season lasts 28 days: 4 boss rounds of 7 days each. The final 10 minutes of every boss round is a settlement phase during which challenges are not allowed. Season 21 was current at snapshot, and the season timer shown in game is time remaining, not season length.
challenge.seal_battle_bosses: The boss rotates each 7-day round. Cyclops Mage was the boss at snapshot.
challenge.seal_battle_ranking: Players are grouped based on registration time. Each boss round's group ranking is by total damage dealt to that boss. Groups are re-ranked at the start of each new boss round from the previous round's standings, and at season end groups are demoted based on the previous season's group rank, with different demotion quotas per rank.
challenge.seal_battle_tiers: Seal Battle has its own tier ladder, shown as banded icons across the top of the ranking screen. Demon Slayer (purple) is the top tier and Elite (yellow) sits below it, with lower tiers beneath. Demon Slayer is a tier name, not a season theme. Each tier ranks separately and rewards scale by tier.
challenge.seal_battle_rewards: Ranking rewards are mailed at the end of each boss round, so 4 times across a 28-day season. Demon Slayer tier: rank 1 gets 5,000 gems plus Seal Battle tokens, rank 2 4,000 gems, rank 3 3,000, rank 4 2,800, rank 5 2,600. Elite tier: rank 1 3,000, rank 2 2,400, rank 3 1,800, rank 4 1,500, rank 5 1,200.
challenge.seal_battle_actions: Quick Raid auto-resolves attempts and is unlocked by the Sealing Master Privilege Card, using your highest damage of the round. Practice gives test runs that do not consume chances, Start is a manual run, and Preset loads a saved gear and rune loadout. The Sealing Master card also Quick-Raids the Monster Invasion guild boss.
challenge.sky_tower_floor_types: Floor groups vary in challenge type - some are multi-boss battles (the label 'Multiple boss battles will occur!' appeared on Floor 2796-2800) and others present different challenges. Read the floor group's challenge label before entering.
challenge.sky_tower_rewards: Per-clear rewards include gems (e.g. 50), keys, gear scrolls (e.g. 550) and other materials. Milestone rewards exist for clearing a floor tier, e.g. 'Claim after clearing Floor 2800'.
challenge.sky_tower_gating: Campaign progression is gated by Sky Tower floor clears, so pushing floors unlocks more campaign content. Floors past 2,700 exist. The Abyssium Conqueror card is important for anyone running Sky Tower actively.
challenge.magic_plant_defense_mechanics: Solo or 2-player co-op PvE defence; difficulty rises in a 2-player team. The host spends a ticket to start and assisting players do not. Assist rewards are capped at 10 per week. 3 tickets replenish weekly and 1 more can be earned from daily tasks; the source estimates a solo host gets up to about 10 tickets a week.
challenge.seal_battle_mechanics: Boss-based PvE challenge. 2 challenges per day, and the Sealing Master Privilege Card adds +1 for 3. Rewards are based on survival time. EXP drops randomly on the field during a run and must be actively collected to upgrade mid-run. Revival is not allowed, with revival gear the only exception.
challenge.sky_tower_mechanics: Ascending floor-based tower, shown in groups of 5 floors (e.g. Floor 2796-2800). Each Start costs 1 entry and daily entries are limited; the Abyssium Conqueror Privilege Card adds +3 daily Sky Tower challenges.

events.fishing: Fishing is one of the most recurring events, happening almost every month. It is one of the main ways to obtain etched runes. Players should prioritize fishing events when they appear.

dungeon.overview: Dungeon modes: Gold Cave, Ruin Ruins, Shackled Jungle, and Abyssal Tide.
dungeon.gold_cave: Gold Cave is a simple dungeon with a max level of 150. Accessible to most players.
dungeon.ruin_ruins: Ruin Ruins gives you keys to unlock chests that contain runes. Most keys come from events or purchases.
dungeon.shackled_jungle: Shackled Jungle is focused on runes and your rune setup. You defeat waves of enemies, picking skills along the way. If you pick skills that synergize with your runes (good rune synergy), you'll do well; without synergy, it's very difficult.
dungeon.abyssal_tide: Abyssal Tide is an endless dungeon with different bonuses and negatives that rotate weekly (randomized, e.g. Meteor bonus, Sprite bonus, reverse controls, poison for standing still). It gives currency to level up your Sacred Hall.
dungeon.shackled_jungle_privilege: The Abyssium Conqueror Card adds +2 daily Shackled Jungle challenges and unlocks Quick-Raid for stages you have already cleared.
dungeon.gold_cave_mechanics: The Cave Explorer Privilege Card adds +2 Gold Cave daily challenges. The source records no other Gold Cave detail.
dungeon.abyssal_tide_mechanics: The Abyssium Conqueror Privilege Card adds +1 daily Abyssal Tide challenge and Quick-Raid functionality. The source records no other Abyssal Tide detail.
dungeon.shackled_jungle_mechanics: Stage-based dungeon gated by power rating (Stage 638 at snapshot). The game shows your current power against the recommended rating for the next stage, e.g. Current 128,130 / Rec. Rating 128,400; if your rating is well below the recommendation, success is unlikely. Each Start costs 1 entry, and a 1st Clear Reward is previewed for the next stage.

game_modes.events_tab: The Events tab groups three categories: Arena (4 PvP modes), Challenge (Magic Plant Defense, Seal Battle, Sky Tower) and Dungeon (Abyssal Tide, Gold Cave, Shackled Jungle). Each sub-feature has its own season or cycle, rewards and shop.
game_modes.event_shop_currencies: Every Arena mode has its own shop and its own currency, so running all four yields different shard pools: Arena Coins for Phynx and Nezha shards, Peak Arena Coins for Loki shards, All-Star Cup tokens for Universal Artifact Shards.
game_modes.privilege_card_raid_synergy: The Sealing Master, Cave Explorer and Abyssium Conqueror Privilege Cards enable Quick-Raid on most Challenge and Dungeon modes and raise their daily run counts. They are the highest-leverage cards for active event grinders.

in_run.blocking_shield_order: When multiple blocking shields are active at once, the one with the shortest remaining duration is consumed first. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
in_run.battle_speed_tiers: Battle speed tiers are standardised: the modes that offer a speed-up run at exactly 1.5x, 2x and 3x. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.

profile_experience.description: Profile experience is your general account or profile level, separate from character or hero stars. It is earned only by playing campaign mode.
profile_experience.example: A player might be profile level 59. When you level up, every 10 levels you unlock the ability to buy cards for gold.
profile_experience.cards_per_10_levels: At each 10th profile level you can buy 10 cards for gold. You keep the cards forever. The cards are randomly generated.
profile_experience.card_effects: Card bonuses include things like Health increase, extra skill refresh, Red heart healing+, speed bonus, and many more. Each purchase gives random rolls.
profile_experience.gold_note: Buying these cards uses gold and can be expensive. This is a rarer use of gold compared to gear leveling and the general store.

tracking_eye.name: Tracking Eye
tracking_eye.description: Your projectiles gain the ability to track enemies. Reduces DMG dealt by 10% (doesn't affect Sprites or elemental damage). Reduces main weapon and Strike projectile speed by 50%. Works best with Oracle Staff or when combined with Piercing Arrow or Energy Beam.

weaken.name: Weaken (debuff)
weaken.description: Weaken is a "hidden" debuff that is applied to enemies via some special enchantments and character skins. Weaken causes the affected enemy to deal 20% less damage. Main sources of weakness include the unique rune enchantments for Arrow Rain and Alex's Duck skin, and the Chaotic level Aura from the Griffin Armor.

archero_skills_wiki.description: The best source to learn more in-depth information on Archero 2 skills.

privilege_cards.description: Privilege Cards provide improved pay-to-play benefits to enhance daily progress.
privilege_cards.community_summary: Permanent Ad-Free Card: 1200 gems on purchase + 20/day, skips ads. Lifetime Supply Card: 3900 gems on purchase + 800 gems/day — strong value for progression. See permanent_ad_free_card and lifetime_supply_card for structured details.

permanent_ad_free_card.name: Permanent Ad-Free Card
permanent_ad_free_card.benefit: Skip ad videos for resources. Best value long term.

lifetime_supply_card.name: Lifetime Supply Card
lifetime_supply_card.benefit: Highly recommended one-time purchase for speeding up progression.

privilege_cards.overview: A set of cards, some lifetime and some monthly, that provide ongoing daily rewards and quality-of-life perks. Accessed from the Privilege Card icon on the main screen left panel.
privilege_cards.pricing_caveat: The numbers shown next to 'Purchase and get' on a card screen are one-time gem bonuses received on purchase, NOT the card's price. Actual prices are not visible to players who already own the cards, so the purchase currency (USD or Aurocite) and amounts were not captured.
privilege_cards.daily_gifts: Free to everyone: 10 gems per day, resets daily.

lifetime_ad_free_card.name: Lifetime Ad-Free Card
lifetime_ad_free_card.benefit: Ad-free forever; increases daily free gems.

privilege_cards.monthly_cards_overview: Each monthly card lasts 30 days. Renewal costs 499 Aurocite, not gems. Initial purchase comes with a 500-gem one-time bonus; the initial purchase price is not visible to current owners.

monthly_card.name: Monthly Card
monthly_card.benefits: New skill refreshes in battle +1, forfeit skill selection, skippable arena battles, skip Peak Arena battle.

hunting_warrior_card.name: Hunting Warrior Card
hunting_warrior_card.benefits: Unlimited multiple Quick Hunts, Max Energy +20, AFK Rewards +20%.

cave_explorer_card.name: Cave Explorer Card
cave_explorer_card.benefits: Gold Cave Daily Challenges +2, unlock Auto-Dig in Rune Ruins.

sealing_master_card.name: Sealing Master Card
sealing_master_card.benefits: Seal Battle Daily Challenges +1; Seal Battle can be Quick-Raided with the highest DMG in this round; Monster Invasion can be Quick-Raided with DMG dealt in the 1st round of the current day.

abyssium_conqueror_card.name: Abyssium Conqueror Card
abyssium_conqueror_card.benefits: Abyssal Tide can be Quick-Raided with the highest DMG dealt in the current day; Daily Abyssal Tide challenges +1; cleared Shackled Jungle stages can be Quick-Raided; Daily Shackled Jungle challenges +2; Daily Sky Tower challenges +3.

daily_gem_totals.note: Gems per day by source when all cards are owned.

recommendation_policy.default_rule: Do NOT recommend purchases to F2P players — it gets annoying fast and is the wrong frame for that audience.
recommendation_policy.f2p_players: Focus advice on free progression, daily routines, and best use of free gems. Mention lifetime cards only if the player asks specifically about value or clearly invites it, and frame them as optional.
recommendation_policy.paying_players: Lifetime Ad-Free plus Lifetime Supply are the two purchases broadly worth recommending to anyone playing actively — they pay back over time.
recommendation_policy.monthly_card_matching: Monthly cards are situational, matched to player activity: heavy Quick Hunts user to Hunting Warrior; active in Gold Cave / Rune Ruins to Cave Explorer; active in Seal Battle / Monster Invasion to Sealing Master; active in Abyssal Tide / Shackled Jungle / Sky Tower to Abyssium Conqueror; heavy Arena player to Monthly Card.

sacred_hall.overview: Sacred Hall is a profile-wide progression system that gives permanent bonuses to all your characters. It is leveled up using currency earned from Abyssal Tide.
sacred_hall.building_effect: The main upgrade path is the Building Effect. Each level gives an attack increase and a health increase.
sacred_hall.tier_upgrades: Separate from building levels, there are tier upgrades that unlock special bonuses. Higher tiers can unlock extra skin slots, which ties into Resonance.
sacred_hall.resonance_skin_interaction: At base level, Resonance is only the ability of a specific character. But if that character has a skin, and your Sacred Hall tier is high enough, you can also get their skin bonus in resonance — not just the ability. This means Sacred Hall tier determines whether resonance includes just abilities or abilities + skins.
sacred_hall.access: Reached from the Sacred Hall button on the hero portrait. A building structure providing global ATK and HP bonuses plus account-wide privileges.

sub_tabs.upgrade: Spend Character Shadows (purple gem currency) to raise Sacred Hall level and apply privileges to the existing structure.
sub_tabs.build: Spend Abyssal Stonework (blue currency) to build/expand Sacred Hall. Separate track from Upgrade.

damage_terminology.note: Community-sourced from #arch-ai !suggest (recovered in full-channel audit). Attack Power, Main weapon DMG, and generic DMG are different stats that multiply together.
damage_terminology.attack_power: Attack Power (ATK / ATK PWR): baseline multiplier N × Attack Power for damage. Some skills claim to buff ATK but don't (e.g. Swift Arrow, source-specific buffs); others change ATK while describing something else (e.g. Stand Strong).
damage_terminology.main_weapon_dmg: Main weapon DMG: only the non-elemental portion of main weapon damage; does not include explosion damage from bow/crossbow. Affected by Front Arrow, Sharp Arrow rune, Chaotic Dragoon crossbow effect.
damage_terminology.generic_dmg: Generic DMG buffs vary: some skills affect many damage sources (Swift Arrow, Tracking Eye, Bane of Bosses), some only one.
damage_terminology.stacking: Attack Power, Main weapon DMG, and DMG are not the same stat; they multiply with each other.

hunt.description: Idle / AFK reward system reached from the Hunt button on the main screen. Pays out rewards passively instead of grinding earlier stages.
hunt.accumulation: Auto-gets rewards over time, accumulating while not playing.
hunt.max_accumulation: 24 hours. After 24h the buffer stops filling — claim before then to avoid wasted time.
hunt.scaling: Later chapters grant better rewards; Hunt's per-hour yield scales with campaign progression.
hunt.reward_types: Gold and EXP, plus a probabilistic mix of gear, gear scrolls and runes. Hunt does not drop hero/character shards.
hunt.claim: The Claim button collects whatever has accumulated, up to the 24h cap.

quick_hunt.description: Instantly receive Hunting rewards without waiting. Two options: free (watch an ad) or an energy run.
quick_hunt.free_ad_option: 1 ad per use. Base 2 free chances per day; more can be earned from various sources.
quick_hunt.hunting_warrior_card: The Hunting Warrior Privilege Card grants unlimited free Quick Hunt chances.
quick_hunt.energy_option: Configurable per click: 5 energy = 1 run, 10 energy = 2 runs, 25 energy = 5 runs. The August 2026 hotfix added a x10 option; its energy cost was not given in the notes.

gear_pieces.sets: Three sets — Destruction, Echo, Decisiveness — across 6 slots, 18 pieces total.
gear_pieces.weapon: Heroic Longbow, Beam Staff, Agile Knuckles
gear_pieces.armor: Armor of Destruction, Echo Armor, Armor of Decisiveness
gear_pieces.boots: Boots of Destruction, Echo Boots, Boots of Decisiveness
gear_pieces.helmet: Helmet of Destruction, Echo Helmet, Helmet of Decisiveness
gear_pieces.ring: Ring of Destruction, Echo Ring, Ring of Decisiveness
gear_pieces.amulet: Amulet of Destruction, Echo Amulet, Amulet of Decisiveness
gear_pieces.set_role: These are the base/entry sets mapping to the three upgrade tiers in the main gear system: Destruction -> Dragoon, Decisiveness -> Griffin, Echo -> Oracle. They share similar bonuses to their upgrade-tier counterparts but more limited.
gear_pieces.use_past_early_game: Mainly used as upgrade fodder to level Dragoon/Griffin/Oracle.

hunt.gear_scrolls: One scroll per slot type: Weapon Scroll, Armor Scroll, Helmet Scroll, Ring Scroll, Amulet Scroll, Boots Scroll.

rune_drops.note: These are runes, not in-run skills. Hunt deposits them straight into the rune inventory.
