advice.claim_before_cap: Always claim Hunt before it caps at 24h — wasted time is wasted rewards.
advice.f2p: Use the 2 free daily ad chances; don't burn energy on Quick Hunt.
advice.hunting_warrior_card_owners: Spam unlimited free Quick Hunts; energy-paid runs are situational.
advice.energy_efficiency: Of the captured tiers, energy-paid Quick Hunts cost the same 5 energy per run at 5/1, 10/2 and 25/5, so none is more efficient than another. The August 2026 hotfix added a x10 option whose energy cost was not given.
advice.push_campaign: Push deeper into the campaign to raise Hunt's hourly rate.

battle_pass.description: Seasonal reward track, reached from the Daily Rewards / Great Value screen via the Battle Pass tab.
battle_pass.season_length: 28 days per pass. After the current pass ends, the next one becomes available.
battle_pass.progression: Complete Daily Tasks to earn activity points (XP). Each level on the pass unlocks rewards in each of the three tracks the player has access to.

exp_carryover.description: At the end of each season, EXP carries over to the next pass based on total EXP earned. Values below are the amount carried over.

battle_pass.post_cap_rewards: Once the pass reaches max level, every additional 50 activity points grants 1 Gray Key (used for Silver Chest pulls). Capped at 20 gray keys per season; activity points earned after that give no further reward for the season.
battle_pass.claim_all: A Claim All button at the bottom of the Battle Pass screen claims every unclaimed reward across the tracks the player has access to.

mystlings.overview: Mystlings are collectible creatures that grant an Active Skill in battle and a passive Collection Stat just for being owned. They are managed from Camp, opened with the Camp button at the bottom-left of the main screen.
mystlings.aspects: Mystlings come in 4 categories, called Aspects: Demon, Undead, Nature and Monster. The Mystling inventory is organised by Aspect.
mystlings.rarity_vs_stars: Each Mystling has a fixed rarity (Common / Rare / Epic / Legendary and so on), locked to one tier per Mystling the way heroes are. The stars shown on a Mystling are its upgrade or ascension level, not its rarity.
mystlings.mystling_detail_screen: A Mystling's detail screen shows its name and star rating, its Active Skill (a deployable battle ability, Lv. 1+), its Collection Stats (a passive bonus from owning it, Lv. 1+), a Star Up button that spends shards or duplicates to raise that one Mystling's stars, and a Deploy button that puts it in the active battle slot.
mystlings.example_death_mage: Death Mage at Active Skill Lv. 1 fires 8 giant scythes, each dealing 160% of character ATK and applying one of ATK -10%, ATK SPD -10%, MOV SPD -10% or Dodge -10% for 5s; reapplying refreshes the duration. Its Lv. 1 Collection Stat is Final DMG Bonus +2%.
mystlings.heart_icons: Two different heart icons exist. On a Mystling's detail page the heart shows the total stars that Mystling has been upgraded across the copies you own. On the Collect page the heart shows your overall collection progress on the milestone track.
mystlings.deploy_cap: Base deploy cap is 1 Mystling. Sacred Hall privileges add +1 Max deployed Mystlings in Peak Arena, Arena and Guild Expedition at higher Sacred Hall tiers (multiple instances), and Mystling collection milestones add +3 Max Mystling dispatches at 20 progress. The cap grows through both progression tracks combined.
mystlings.collection_progress: The Collect button on the Mystling screen opens a milestone reward track. Total collection progress, counted from the heart and star icons on your Mystling cards, unlocks permanent account-wide bonuses at thresholds. The snapshot player sat at 492 progress on a track that runs past 2,600.
mystlings.collection_milestones_early: 2: camp naming permission. 5: Mystling hatchery slot +2. 10: Mystling hatching duration -720s. 15: Pact Sanctum upgrade time -5%. 20: Max Mystling dispatches +3. After that a new milestone lands roughly every 20-30 progress.
mystlings.collection_milestones_mid: 420: Pact Sanctum upgrade time -5%. 440: Guild assist reward chances +2. 460: after taking damage 1 time, DMG REDUC +0.6% (max 10 stacks). 480: Pact Sanctum upgrade time -5%. 500: assisted help requests extra -60s.
mystlings.collection_milestones_late: 1030: each time an active skill is used, DMG +1.25% (max 20 stacks). 1060: when battle starts, 50% chance to prevent 1 player dealing damage for 3s. 1090: after taking damage 1 time, DMG REDUC +1.5% (max 10 stacks). 1120: ATK PWR +15%. 1150: Max HP +15%. 1900: battle-start prevent chance 90%. 1950: DMG REDUC +2.7% (max 10 stacks). 2000: ATK PWR +15%. 2050: Max HP +15%. 2100: cooldown of active Mystling skills reduced +5%. 2200: each active skill use gives DMG +2.5% (max 20 stacks). 2300: battle-start prevent chance 100%. 2400: DMG REDUC +3% (max 10 stacks). 2500: ATK PWR +15%. 2600: Max HP +15%.
mystlings.collection_patterns: ATK PWR +15% and Max HP +15% repeat at several thresholds and stack meaningfully. Pact Sanctum upgrade time -5% also repeats. Hatchery, hatching-speed and dispatch-cap upgrades front-load in early progress, while combat-defensive bonuses layer in throughout.
mystlings.collection_strategy: The collection track is a large permanent power source: account-wide, it never resets, and it complements Sacred Hall and rune progression. Hatching new Mystlings raises the counter and unlocks more global buffs even if you never deploy them.
mystlings.camp_overview: Camp is a customisable town containing three buildings - Pact Sanctum, Magic Plant Defense and the Hatchery - plus the Mystling collection. The player names their own camp, and naming unlocks at 2 Mystling collection progress.
mystlings.pact_sanctum: The Camp building that sets the passive ATK and HP buffs your active hero gains whenever ANY Mystling is deployed. Observed at Lv.120: ATK Increase +8,020 and HP Up +32,080, with the next level previewing ATK +8,780 and HP +35,420.
mystlings.pact_sanctum_upgrades: Upgrades cost Gold plus Spirit Pact Seed (a blue plum-seed-shaped item) and take real time - about 42 minutes per level at Lv.120, scaling with level. Mystling collection milestones repeatedly cut Pact Sanctum upgrade time by 5%.
mystlings.hatchery: The Camp building where new Mystlings are hatched. 8 egg slots were visible in a circle, and slot count scales with collection progress (+2 slots at 5 progress). Hatching duration is reduced by collection milestones (-720s at 10 progress).
mystlings.bulk_hatching: Bulk Hatching processes multiple eggs at once and has two settings. Egg priority: higher rarity first (the default for grinding stronger Mystlings) or lower rarity first. Aspect: Demon, Undead, Nature or Monster - choosing an Aspect guarantees the hatched Mystlings are of that Aspect, which is how you fill out a specific Aspect collection.
mystlings.magic_plant_defense_building: Magic Plant Defense sits in Camp because defending the magic plant uses your Mystlings. From its entry screen it offers Solo Challenge and Team Challenge, shows a Drop Chance preview of 4 reward types, and carries its own Exchange Shop, Tasks, ranking sidebar and recruit chat for team challenges.

currencies.overview: Reference for the currencies and consumable resources shown in the header bar, shop screens and pack screens.

energy.use: Consumed to play stages: 5 energy per attempt.
energy.cap_increases: Privilege Cards and other buffs raise the cap; the Hunting Warrior Card adds +20.

power_level.icon: Gold arrow / chevron badge, top header bar.
power_level.use: Not spent. Represents total combat power across gear, heroes and runes; a progress indicator only.

gold.use: Soft currency. Used for upgrades and most non-premium purchases.

gems.not_used_for: NOT used to buy Privilege Cards or Daily Reward packs.
gems.used_for: Gear chests (Mythstone, Chromatic, Silver, Obsidian), Wishes, certain items in the first daily shop section, and buying additional event tries during temporary events.
gems.source: Many Privilege Cards pay out daily in gems.

aurocite.icon: Pink triangle gem; appears on shop, pack and Privilege Card renewal screens.
aurocite.used_for: Renewing Privilege Cards (499 Aurocite/month) and buying Daily Reward packs (99 / 199 / 299 / 499 Aurocite).
aurocite.habby_store_bonus: The '+10% bonus Aurocite when purchasing from the Habby Store' banner refers to this currency.
aurocite.default_currency_behavior: The game treats Aurocite as its default real-money currency. If your Aurocite balance covers a paid item's price, the price is displayed in Aurocite; if not, it falls back to local fiat currency (USD for this player).
aurocite.display_caveat: The same purchase can therefore appear priced differently to different players depending on their Aurocite balance.
aurocite.usd_conversion: Aurocite maps directly to real money at 100 Aurocite = $1 USD. So 99 Aurocite is $0.99, 499 Aurocite is $4.99, 4999 Aurocite is $49.99. Any Aurocite price is a real-money price.

currencies.icon_confusion_warning: Power Level uses a gold arrow/chevron badge and Aurocite uses a pink triangle gem - easy to confuse. Power Level lives in the main screen header; Aurocite shows up on shop, pack and Privilege Card renewal screens.

gear_chest_keys.rule: Each chest type uses its own key. 1 key = 1 pull, or spend Gems if you are out of keys.
gear_chest_keys.purple_to_blue_key: Mythstone Chest AND Chromatic Chest (shared key).

character_shadows.source: Shard Exchange, where excess hero shards convert 1:1, plus other progression rewards.

enchantium.use: Standard Enchantizer pulls, 1,000 Enchantium per pull.
enchantium.gem_conversion: Convertible from gems at escalating rates - e.g. the 21st-30th purchase costs 300 gems/attempt and the 31st-40th costs 400 gems/attempt.

advanced_enchantium.use: Advanced Enchantizer pulls, 1 Advanced Enchantium per pull.
advanced_enchantium.value: Drop rates roughly 44x better for Mythic than the standard Enchantizer.
advanced_enchantium.source: Earned passively at 1 per 100 standard Enchant pulls; also directly purchasable.

spirit_pact_seed.use: Pact Sanctum upgrades, spent alongside gold.
spirit_pact_seed.source: Confirmed source is the Magic Plant Defense Exchange Shop. The source suspects Mystling-related events and rewards also grant it, but did not confirm.

hero_shards.rule: Each hero is unlocked and starred up with shards specific to that hero; there are no universal shards.
hero_shards.sources: Hunt, Daily Rewards (Bonus Pack), Limited Offer packs, and events.
hero_shards.excess_shards: Convert to Character Shadows via the Sacred Hall Shard Exchange.

pack_and_chest_items.note: The source flags this whole group as needing verification.
pack_and_chest_items.phynx_shards: Hero shards used to unlock and upgrade the Phynx hero.
pack_and_chest_items.wish_coin: Currency for the Wish system; further detail not captured (TBD).
pack_and_chest_items.relic_shovel: Relic Shovel is a digging item. runes.promised_ruins records it as the Promised Ruins dig cost ('300 Gems, or 1 Relic Shovel'); Rune Ruins uses a Ruin Shovel instead. See shovel_disambiguation.
pack_and_chest_items.draw_item_choice_chest: When opened, lets you pick one of: 1x Chromatic Chest key, 1x Wish Coin, 2x Relic Shovel.
pack_and_chest_items.shovel_disambiguation: Three shovel names appear in the data: Ruin Shovel (Rune Ruins dig cost), Relic Shovel (Promised Ruins dig cost), and Promised Ruin Shovel, added to the Guild Shop and Arena Shop in the August 2026 hotfix. Whether the Promised Ruin Shovel is the same item as the Relic Shovel is NOT documented — do not treat them as the same, and say so if asked.

daily_rewards.description: Daily-resetting set of value packs centered on hero shards, reached from the Great Value icon on the main screen left panel.
daily_rewards.reset: Packs reset daily (~24h timer shown at the top of the screen).
daily_rewards.selected_hero: A Swap Character selection sets which hero's shards and themed rewards the pack contents are built around. Default seen: Phynx.
daily_rewards.buy_all_special_packs: Bulk option to buy all special packs at once: 499 Aurocite, advertised as Value 1700%.
daily_rewards.habby_store_bonus: In-game banner: receive +10% bonus Aurocite when purchasing from the Habby Store.

bonus_pack_shard_rates.description: Drop rates for the free Bonus Pack's Random Hero Shard Pack (Phynx version).

daily_rewards.paid_pack_contents: Value, Featured and Deluxe packs each contain a mix of items including hero shards, gold, gems, and a Draw Item Choice Chest.
daily_rewards.draw_item_choice_chest: Lets the player choose one of: 1x Chromatic Chest key, 1x Wish Coin, 2x Relic Shovel.

rules.one_purchase_per_day: Packs are limited to 1 purchase per day and reset daily.
rules.hero_swap: You can swap heroes for different pack options; the selected hero changes which shards drop.
rules.bulk_discount: Buying all packs at once gives a greater discount. Once you have purchased any pack individually, the bulk option becomes unavailable.
rules.hero_lock: After purchasing any paid pack, you can no longer swap hero packs — the selected hero is locked in for the day.

main_screen.energy: Energy gates stage attempts and regenerates on a timer (snapshot showed 24/80 with 05:42 to the next tick). Base max energy is 20 for new players; the cap is raised by Privilege Cards and other buffs.
main_screen.stage_energy_cost: The 'x5' shown next to the large yellow Start button is the energy cost per stage attempt - 5 energy per attempt - not a multi-run multiplier.
main_screen.power_level: Power Level is your total combat power (e.g. 8.5M), shown in the top header with a gold arrow/chevron badge.
main_screen.power_level_vs_aurocite: Power Level (gold arrow/chevron badge) and Aurocite (pink triangle gem, seen only on shop and pack screens) are different things and are easy to confuse.
main_screen.gems_not_pack_currency: Gems are the green currency in the top header. They are NOT the payment currency for Privilege Cards or packs.
main_screen.campaign_progress_display: The centre of the main screen shows your current campaign stage by name (e.g. 'Poison Realm') with 'Best: X/Y', where X is the highest wave you have cleared and Y is the total waves in that stage.
main_screen.sky_tower_gating: A banner on the main screen names the Sky Tower floor you must clear to unlock the next campaign level - example text: clear Sky Tower Floor 1500 to access the next level once the current one is passed. Sky Tower clearance gates campaign progression.
main_screen.hub_entry_points: The main screen is the hub for everything else: Hunt (a quick-reward alternative to farming stages), Reach (current campaign progress such as 123-50, which opens the clearance rewards), Guild, Camp (Mystlings), Rankings, Task Center, Friends, and the five bottom tabs Shop, Gear, Campaign, Collectible and Events.
main_screen.temporary_event_entries: Eternal Lode and Contract Mystling are temporary events reached from the right side panel, alongside Island Treasure. Umbral Tempest is a large event opened from the bottom action bar.
main_screen.rotating_deal_timer: A countdown on the left panel tracks a rotating limited-time deal. The source notes most of these are not considered worthwhile to most players.

event_shop.location: One stop in the bottom-tab shop carousel reached from the Guild Store / Arena Shop / Skin Exchange Shop screens. Carousel order left to right: Guild Store, Event Shop, Arena Shop (sub-tabs Arena Shop / Peak Arena Shop), Skin Exchange Shop.
event_shop.description: A multi-event vendor with one top-level tab per active or recurring event. Each tab holds its own milestone-gated stock.
event_shop.sub_tabs: Island Store (the Island Treasure Hunt event) and Darksurge Vault.
event_shop.currency: Event-specific tokens, different per tab. Island Store prices are in a yellow-icon currency the source calls Island Tokens; the exact name is unconfirmed. Observed item costs: 2, 4, 5, 10, 11, 12.

island_store.refresh: In-game text: 'Refreshed when the Island Treasure Hunt event starts' - the entire stock cycles when a new Island Treasure Hunt event begins.
island_store.limit_caveat: The source's limit column is headed 'Daily/event limit' without saying which applies.

always_available.note: Top tier of the shop, stocked without a milestone gate.
always_available.not_captured: Demon Blood Shard, Cupid's Arrow Shard and Cupid's Bow Shard are also stocked; their cost and limit were not captured.

milestone_gates.mechanic: Stock tiers are gated behind progression labels reading 'Island Points reach X to unlock'. Higher tiers unlock progressively rarer items.
milestone_gates.island_points_200000: Defiance of Fate Artifact Choice Chest (cost 2), Limited Mythic Artifact Shard Choice Chest (cost 10), Choice Epic Etched Rune Chest (cost 12).
milestone_gates.island_points_300000: Character Shadows x350 (cost 10), Thor Shard - Legendary hero (cost 11), Limited Mythic Artifact Shard Choice Chest (cost 11).
milestone_gates.island_points_400000: Cleo Shard (Legendary hero), Legendary Character Universal Shard, Choice Epic Etched Rune Chest. Costs not captured.

event_shop.darksurge_vault: The second event tab. Contents were not captured (TBD).

advice.legendary_shard_path: Island Treasure Hunt events trade event participation (Island Points) for Legendary hero shards - Otta, Thor, Cleo - that the standard Guild Store does not stock, since it only carries Rare. Events are the primary Legendary hero progression path for active F2P players.
advice.milestone_planning: Milestone progression is high leverage: plan participation to clear the highest Island Points tier (200K / 300K / 400K) you can reach each event.

event_shop.unconfirmed: Exact currency name for the Event Shop, Darksurge Vault contents, and how Island Points are earned during the event.

skin_exchange_shop.location: Last stop in the bottom-tab shop carousel (Guild Store, Event Shop, Arena Shop, Skin Exchange Shop).
skin_exchange_shop.description: The dedicated vendor for weapon skins - both buying new skins and exchanging for upgraded variants.
skin_exchange_shop.sub_tabs: Hero Skin Shop (main purchase tab) and Reforger Shop (skin upgrade/exchange tab).
skin_exchange_shop.currency: Items cost 6 or 12 of a yellow-icon currency; the exact name was not captured (the source guesses Skin Tokens or Reforger Coins). Contributor's balance at capture: 4 of a green-icon currency and 6 of the yellow-icon one.
skin_exchange_shop.purchase_limit: Every item showed 'Purchases left: 6' - a fixed limit per event cycle.

hero_skin_shop.note: Current rotation observed by the contributor, not a permanent catalogue.
hero_skin_shop.cost_12_skins: Awakened Stone Monkey, Violet Lotus Pulse, Conqueror of Battles, Golden Velvet Carol, Eternal Nightglow, Fiery Reckoning, Waxwane Judgment, Lightning Essence, Abyssal Guide.
hero_skin_shop.cost_6_skins: Illusion Essence, Ice Diva, Nian Slayer - Prosperity, Nian Slayer - Longevity, Seraduckus, Duckoola, Waddla, Empowered Curse, Life Essence.
hero_skin_shop.rarity_hypothesis: The source suspects the cost-12 tier is higher rarity than the cost-6 tier, going by icon background colour, but did not confirm it.
hero_skin_shop.snapshot_sold_out: Golden Velvet Carol (cost 12), Empowered Curse and Life Essence (cost 6) showed Sold Out because the contributor had already bought them.

skin_exchange_shop.reforger_shop: The skin upgrade/reforge tab. Reforge-specific rules and costs were not captured; the Griffin/Oracle skin screens documented in gear.md come from here.
skin_exchange_shop.naming_note: These are weapon skin names, not character names. Each skin is tied to a gear set (Griffin / Dragoon / Oracle).
skin_exchange_shop.advice: Purchase limits are per event cycle, so buy the highest-value skins for your set and build first - you cannot re-buy once the limit is spent.
skin_exchange_shop.unconfirmed: Exact currency name, whether cost 6 versus cost 12 maps to a specific rarity, and Reforger Shop pricing and exchange mechanics.

reach_rewards.description: One-time rewards for campaign progression, reached from the 'Reach [chapter-wave]' button on the main screen (e.g. Reach 123-50).
reach_rewards.sub_tabs: Three tabs: Clear Reward, Hard Mode Clear Reward, and Star Challenge.

clear_reward.description: Rewards granted one-time per wave reached in the campaign.
clear_reward.structure: A chapter carousel lets you view rewards by chapter and wave. Each wave milestone gives a fixed reward bundle.
clear_reward.example: Chapter 123, Wave 50: 200 Gems, 5 Energy, 13 Gear Scrolls.
clear_reward.advice: Clear Rewards are one-time, so prioritize them whenever approaching a wave you have not been past before. After campaign progression, open Reach Rewards and claim the new milestones.

gear_scrolls.per_slot: Gear Scrolls are slot-specific, not generic. Each scroll is one of: Weapon Scroll, Armor Scroll, Helmet Scroll, Ring Scroll, Amulet Scroll, Boots Scroll.
gear_scrolls.use: Used to upgrade that slot's gear level (1-200).
gear_scrolls.same_as_hunt: The same resource that drops from Hunt — Hunt's yellow scroll icon represents one of these 6 slot-specific scrolls.

reach_rewards.hard_mode_clear_reward: Second sub-tab (gold crown). Contents were not documented in the source contribution.

star_challenge.description: Per-stage challenge objectives that grant up to 3 stars per stage.
star_challenge.how_stars_work: Each stage lists 3 objectives. Meeting an objective on a clear earns 1 star, 3 stars max per stage.
star_challenge.common_objectives: Clear time doesn't exceed [time] (e.g. 09:30); less than X attacks received (e.g. 5 or 10); doesn't trigger revive; defeat more than X monsters (e.g. 800).
star_challenge.star_rewards: Payouts are cumulative milestones on total stars across all stages. Every 3 stars (e.g. 306, 309, 312, 318, 321) gives 500 gems; major milestones (e.g. 315) give 5,000 gems.
star_challenge.reward_scaling: Rewards start small at low star counts and build progressively as stars accumulate, with periodic large-bonus milestones. Exact cadence was not confirmed in the source contribution.

example_stages.stage_101_silentwood: Clear time <= 09:30; less than 5 attacks; no revive.
example_stages.stage_102_celestia_sanctum: Defeat 800+ monsters; less than 10 attacks; no revive.
example_stages.stage_103_mired_abyss: Clear time <= 09:30; less than 5 attacks; no revive.

star_challenge.advice: A slow gem income channel. Attempt easier-stage stars first; the 5,000-gem milestones are worth chasing.

shop.overview: The bottom-nav Shop tab. Contains everything purchasable in the game, organised into 5 top-level sub-tabs.
shop.sub_tabs: Daily Shop (default), Gear Chest, Wish, Limited Offer, Top Up.

daily_shop.refresh: Refreshes every 24h; items rotate, so gear, scrolls and shards differ each refresh.
daily_shop.grid: 6 items per refresh. Each shows 'Purchases left: 1' and a price.
daily_shop.item_types: Base-set gear (Destruction / Decisiveness / Echo), gear scrolls, or hero/character shards. Currency varies - both Gems and Gold appear.

observed_items.note: Example rotation captured by the contributor, not a fixed stock list.
observed_items.helix_shard: Sold out at capture time; price not shown.

daily_shop.chapter_pack: Featured at the top of the screen: a one-time-only USD pack tied to a specific campaign chapter, unlocked at a chapter milestone. Observed: 'Ch. 122 Gift Pack - 600% Value - $99.99'.

gear_chest.overview: Four chest types. Pulls cost keys (1 key = 1 pull) or can be bought with Gems if you are out of keys. Each chest type uses its own key.

keys.purple_to_blue_key: Mythstone Chest AND Chromatic Chest (shared key).

gear_chest.guaranteed_prize_rule: When the guaranteed prize is triggered, all item drop rates within that tier are equal.
gear_chest.s_rank_rarity_floor: The '5-star Epic Gear' tier in the Mythstone and Chromatic tables means S-Ranked gear at Epic minimum. S-Ranked pieces (Dragoon / Griffin / Oracle) only drop at Epic rarity or higher; they never drop as Common, Fine or Rare.

mythstone_chest.contents: Rare or Epic gear; chance of obtaining 5-star Epic gear increased.
mythstone_chest.series_tabs: Griffin / Oracle / Dragoon - pick the series you pull from.
mythstone_chest.pull_cost: 1 purple-blue key per pull, or pay in Gems.
mythstone_chest.pity: Base pity values were not captured from the in-game Rules popup. In-game pity counters are per-account, so the 'X opens to guarantee' numbers a player sees are specific to that account.

drop_rates.note: Excludes the minimum guarantee; stated to total 100%.

chromatic_chest.contents: Rare or Epic gear; chance of obtaining 5-star Epic gear increased.
chromatic_chest.pull_cost: 1 purple-blue key per pull (shared with Mythstone), or pay in Gems.
chromatic_chest.pity: Values shown in game (Epic within X opens; 5-Star Epic within Y opens) are per-account counters, not base rates. Base values were not captured.

silver_chest.pull_cost: 1 gray key, or pay in Gems.

obsidian_chest.free_draw: 1 free pull every ~2 days (timer observed at 1d 06h).
obsidian_chest.pull_cost: 1 purple key, or pay in Gems.
obsidian_chest.pity: Obsidian does have a pity counter, but the base threshold was not captured. On-screen values are the player's personal progress toward pity, not the base threshold.

gear_chest.draw_options: All Gear Chests have a 100x Draw option, added in the August 2026 hotfix. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.

wish.description: Pull artifacts from a wish mechanic, with a small angel-like character animation.
wish.pull_cost: Wish coins, a currency obtained from packs and events.
wish.pull_options: Wish x10 or Wish x100. The display reads as held/cost - e.g. 16/10 means 16 wish coins held and 10 per x10 pull.
wish.pity: The in-game display showed Epic Artifact guaranteed within 18 chances and Legendary or Mythic within 78 chances. These are the player's current pity counters, not base values; base rates were not confirmed from the Rules popup.
wish.guarantee_split: When the guarantee is triggered: 90% Legendary / 10% Mythic. Within a rarity, all artifacts have equal appearance rates.
wish.daily_special_pack_section: A section inside the Wish tab: 3 packs that refresh daily, a mix of Aurocite-priced and USD-priced (e.g. 99 Aurocite, $9.99) at '400% Value'.

limited_offer.overview: Four sub-tabs of paid bundles at varying price tiers. Each pack typically shows a '% Value' badge advertising the discount versus buying its contents separately.
limited_offer.daily_special: Refreshes every 24h. 6 packs, a mix of Aurocite (e.g. 99) and USD ($9.99 / $19.99 / $25.99 / $49.99). Most flagged '400% Value'.
limited_offer.weekly_special: Refreshes once per week. 9+ packs at 450% Value, ranging from 499 Aurocite to $99.99. (A 03d 06h timer was time remaining on the current week.)
limited_offer.supreme_collection: Also called the Supreme Treasure Store. Refreshes daily (06:59 timer). All packs 600% Value and all $99.99 - the high-spend tier.

top_up.overview: Direct currency purchases, in three sub-tabs: Gems, Gold, Aurocite.
top_up.currency_display_behavior: The game treats Aurocite as the default real-money currency. If your Aurocite balance covers the price, it shows in Aurocite; if not, it falls back to USD or local currency. The same pack can appear priced differently depending on your Aurocite balance.

gems.note: Paid with Aurocite or USD, depending on Aurocite balance. First-purchase bonus gems are listed where the pack has one.
gems.pile_of_gems: 500 gems for 499 Aurocite; no first-purchase bonus.

gold.note: Paid with Gems. Section refreshes daily (06:59 timer).

aurocite.note: Paid with USD only. In-game text: 'Aurocite can be used to purchase all paid in-game items.'
aurocite.habby_store_bonus: 'Receive +10% bonus Aurocite when purchasing from the Habby Store' - the Habby Store is an external/web purchase channel that grants the bonus.

advice.f2p_daily_shop: Always check it, especially for discounted gear and scrolls under 100 Gems.
advice.f2p_obsidian_chest: Claim the free pull every ~2 days.
advice.f2p_wish: No specific timing advice - use the x10 or x100 pulls whenever you prefer.
advice.f2p_skip: Skip Limited Offer, Top Up, the Chapter Pack, and paid Mythstone/Chromatic pulls.
advice.paying_best_value: Best dollar-per-value is Daily Special packs and the Supreme Treasure Store at $99.99 (600% Value).
advice.paying_aurocite: Buy Aurocite through the Habby Store whenever possible for the +10% bonus.
advice.paying_gold_packs: Skip Top Up gold packs - gold is easy to farm and the conversion rate is bad.
advice.paying_chest_pulls: For Mythstone/Chromatic pulls, pull on the series matching your active gear progression (Griffin / Oracle / Dragoon).

umbral_tempest.overview: Umbral Tempest is a large recurring seasonal event in Archero 2, opened from the bottom action bar on the home screen. It runs in numbered seasons.
umbral_tempest.season_4_status: Umbral Tempest Season 4 begins 31 August 2026. Season 4 detail here comes from the official Archero 2 patch notes of 28 Aug 2026 and describes the season as ANNOUNCED, not as observed in play.
umbral_tempest.season_4_class_abilities: Umbral Tempest Season 4 gives each class a new exclusive Class Ability: Ranger gains 'Sword Will', Alchemist gains 'Thermancy', Druid gains 'Symbiosis', and Diviner gains 'Star Eclipse'. Each class gets more distinct combat mechanics and skill combinations. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
umbral_tempest.season_4_monster_mechanic: Umbral Tempest Season 4 adds the 'Main Weapon Restriction Shield' monster mechanic: while the shield is active the damage dealt by your main weapon is limited, so break it fast using your other skills rather than leaning on your main weapon. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
umbral_tempest.ebonrot_front: Ebonrot Front is named in the Umbral Tempest Season 4 notes, which improve its stage difficulty, its unlock pacing and its weekly resource progress, and list it as one of the four objective areas of the Season Launch 7-Day Tasks. What Ebonrot Front actually is is NOT stated — it has stages, and nothing else about it is documented.
umbral_tempest.doomsday_clash: Doomsday Clash is a boss encounter in Umbral Tempest Season 4. Season 4 improves its boss unlock pacing and adds a Solo Challenge mode, and it is one of the four objective areas of the Season Launch 7-Day Tasks. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
umbral_tempest.season_4_launch_missions: Umbral Tempest Season 4 adds Season Launch 7-Day Tasks spanning four objective areas — Class Talent, Ebonrot Front, Solitary Trial and Doomsday Clash — whose objectives you complete to claim the task rewards. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
umbral_tempest.season_talent_system: The Season Talent System is Umbral Tempest's per-season talent tree. Season 4 upgrades it with talent branches, special nodes, and 6 class skill nodes, allowing targeted enhancement of Class Abilities. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
umbral_tempest.season_talent_resets: From Umbral Tempest Season 4, Season Talent reset rules are 7 resets per week with a weekly reset, for more freedom in your build. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
umbral_tempest.coverage_caveat: Coverage of Umbral Tempest is thin: everything recorded is Season 4 announcement material. The event's core loop, currencies, rewards and past seasons are NOT documented. Do not infer general Umbral Tempest mechanics from these Season 4 notes.
umbral_tempest.season_4_class_ability_old_names: 'Sword Intent' is NOT a current ability name — it is the superseded preview name for the Ranger's Season 4 Class Ability, which is officially called 'Sword Will'. Likewise 'Boiling' is the superseded preview name for the Alchemist's 'Thermancy'. Always answer with Sword Will and Thermancy, and say the old name was replaced.
umbral_tempest.solitary_trial: Solitary Trial is named in the official Umbral Tempest Season 4 patch notes (28 Aug 2026) only as one of the four objective areas of the Season Launch 7-Day Tasks. Nothing else about it is documented.
umbral_tempest.class_talent: Class Talent is named in the Season 4 notes only as one of the four objective areas of the Season Launch 7-Day Tasks. It is NOT the same thing as a Class Ability (the new per-class skill) or the Season Talent System (the per-season talent tree). Nothing else about Class Talent is documented.
umbral_tempest.solitary_trial_vs_solo_challenge: Two different solo-named things in Season 4: Solitary Trial is one of the four 7-Day Task objective areas, and Solo Challenge is a mode added to Doomsday Clash. They are not the same, and neither is documented beyond that. Do not describe one using the other.
umbral_tempest.classes: Umbral Tempest has its own CLASSES — Ranger, Alchemist, Druid and Diviner — which are separate from the heroes in the characters category. How you pick or change class is NOT documented; only the Season 4 Class Abilities are.
umbral_tempest.sword_will_not_sword_strike: 'Sword Will' is the Ranger's Umbral Tempest Season 4 Class Ability. It is NOT 'Sword Strike', which is a rune theme, an Etched rune family, a Promised Ruins group and an All-Star Cup season theme. Different things — do not answer one with the other's data.
umbral_tempest.alchemist_class_not_talent_card: The Alchemist in Umbral Tempest Season 4 is a CLASS that gains the 'Thermancy' Class Ability. It is not the 'Alchemist' Talent Card in collectibles, which grants Rune Drop Rate +18%. Same word, two unrelated things.
umbral_tempest.main_weapon_restriction_shield_disambigu: The 'Main Weapon Restriction Shield' is a Season 4 MONSTER mechanic. It is unrelated to the 'Main Weapon' rune theme and its Etched/Ability rune families. Do not answer a question about this shield with rune-theme data.

collaborations.overview: Collaborations are limited-time crossover events in Archero 2 that add guest characters, skins and event gameplay from another franchise.
collaborations.rick_and_morty_overview: The Archero 2 x Rick and Morty crossover was announced in an in-game 'Collaboration Event Preview' Notice. It brings new characters, exclusive gameplay, and a set of limited-time events. Rick & Morty and all related characters are (c) & TM Cartoon Network.
collaborations.rick_and_morty_rick: Rick is a Legendary crossover character. His combat style revolves around [Garage Inventions] and [Inspiration], combining unpredictable outcomes with powerful scaling. Obtained for a limited time through [Interdimensional Summon] during the event.
collaborations.rick_and_morty_morty: Morty is a Legendary crossover character. His gameplay revolves around the cycle between [Morty Waves], [Lame Adventure] and [Aw Geez Adventure]. On entering battle [Morty Waves] activates automatically, periodically cleansing 1 debuff (excluding control effects) from each ally within range while granting [Lame Adventure] stacks. Obtained for a limited time through [Interdimensional Summon].
collaborations.rick_and_morty_meeseeks: Mr. Meeseeks is a Legendary Mystling debuting in the Rick and Morty collab. His combat style is built around rapid triggers and escalating power; when activated, his skill deals damage to enemies in the target area. Obtained through participation or summoning in the [Meeseeks Directive] event during the collab.
collaborations.rick_and_morty_space_adventures: [Space Adventures] is the collab's limited-time themed stage: a two-player co-op challenge mode. The Rick and Morty collab characters are provided for players to use, so the mode focuses on teamwork and on hands-on experience with each character's skills. Entered from the main event screen. Completing battle quests earns event currency and rare items.
collaborations.rick_and_morty_event_features: Five limited-time features run during the collab: [Interdimensional Summon] (recruitment for Rick and Morty), [Prime Protocol] (recruitment for character and weapon skins), [Meeseeks Directive] (obtain the Legendary Mystling Mr. Meeseeks), [21-Day Login Event] (free login rewards through the event period), and [Server Support Pack] plus [Alliance Treasure] (free rewards or high-value rare items).
collaborations.rick_and_morty_skins: [Prime Protocol] is the collab's limited-time skin recruitment, covering both character skins and weapon skins. Each Rick and Morty collab character has 2 skin sets: one based on the original animated style, and one exclusive to Archero 2. This applies to the collab characters, not to the base roster.
collaborations.rick_and_morty_requirements: To access all Rick and Morty collab content, chapter progress must reach Chapter 3 wave 10 or above, which is what unlocks the in-game event system. The [Alliance Treasure] gameplay additionally requires the player to have joined a guild.
collaborations.rick_and_morty_dates: The Archero 2 x Rick and Morty collab event ends on or about 11 September 2026 — XYIAN reported on 2026-08-24 that it had exactly 18 days left. The start date is not recorded. The in-game event screen carries the authoritative countdown, so point players there for the exact end time.
